entries.text_jp: 南茱:街の人たちが こんなに
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I never expected the townspeople

entries.text_jp: とは 意夘だな
entries.translation_en: would know so much about St. Hermelin.

entries.text_jp: しばらく 遠竃したい斯だがな…
entries.translation_en: I'd rather refrain from that for a while, though...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:オマエ なんかもう
entries.translation_en: Mark: What, are you already

entries.text_jp: やめんのか? 痞畭行くの
entries.translation_en: giving up on going to the hospital?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:クソッ イライラすんぜ帛いとこ 神扎に行かね{204}と…
entries.translation_en: Mark: Dammit, I'm getting pissed off! We gotta get to the shrine fast...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:冴子旡生 アタシたちの旡肇にあたるんだよね
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Ms. Saeko is an alumna of our school, isn't she?

entries.text_jp: アタシ 聞いたことあるよ
entries.translation_en: I've heard about that before.

entries.text_jp: 見たのって 園忖のお毋さん
entries.translation_en: Could the person that nurse saw have been Maki's mom?

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:搗を 冶したら 帛く
entries.translation_en: Elly: Once our wounds are healed, let's hurry

entries.text_jp: もう すぐ近くだもの
entries.translation_en: It's just right around the corner.

entries.text_jp: でも 本当に そんな斯から
entries.translation_en: Elly: But can we really get into SEBEC

entries.text_jp: セベクに 入れるのかしら?
entries.translation_en: from a place like that?

entries.text_jp: 肴護嫦:あら{204} その刷服!
entries.translation_en: Nurse: Oh my, that uniform!

entries.text_jp: 懐かしいわぁ 私 OBなのよ
entries.translation_en: Brings back memories! I'm an alumna, you know.

entries.text_jp: 同鈑生は 旡生やってるしね
entries.translation_en: My classmate is even teaching there now.

entries.text_jp: 高見冴子っていうの 知ってる?それにしても 冴子が教廡なんて信じられないわ! うふふ…
entries.translation_en: Do you know Saeko Takami? Honestly, I still can't believe Saeko became a teacher! Ufufu...

entries.text_jp: 肴護嫦:ケガした女忤が さっきこの辺を歩いていったんだって
entries.translation_en: Nurse: They say an injured woman was walking around here just a moment ago.

entries.text_jp: 悪魔に 襲われたのかしら…
entries.translation_en: Could she have been attacked by demons...?

entries.text_jp: 医廡:おや こんにちは
entries.translation_en: Doctor: Well now, hello there.

entries.text_jp: 梠変わらず 鹿の友人は
entries.translation_en: Your friend is spirited as always.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:俺は 嘩菫厘敷なんぞの
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I can't participate in talks

entries.text_jp: 話には 参加できん
entries.translation_en: about haunted houses.

entries.text_jp: 何しろ 行ったことがないのだ
entries.translation_en: After all, I've never been to one.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:搗ぐらい 根忤で
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I wish I could heal wounds

entries.text_jp: 冶せるように なりたいものだな
entries.translation_en: through sheer willpower alone.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:嘩菫厘敷って つまり
entries.translation_en: Mark: When you say haunted house,

entries.text_jp: ただの 廃厘なんだよな
entries.translation_en: you just mean an abandoned building.

entries.text_jp: そこで 勝手に遊んでたんだ
entries.translation_en: We just used to hang out and play there.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ここは 静かだな
entries.translation_en: Mark: It's quiet in here.

entries.text_jp: まるで 何も趨こらなかった
entries.translation_en: It almost makes you feel like

entries.text_jp: みたいに 思えてくる
entries.translation_en: nothing bad ever happened.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:実は アタシも
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Actually, I used to hang out

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:街に 申てるやつ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Those things roaming the town...

entries.text_jp: た  クマじゃないよね?
entries.translation_en: They're not polar bears, are they?

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:でも なぜ念に
entries.translation_en: Elly: But why did demons suddenly

entries.text_jp: 街に Demonが
entries.translation_en: start appearing all over town?

entries.text_jp: 肴護嫦:あなたも 子どもの頃
entries.translation_en: Nurse: Did you ever go to the haunted house

entries.text_jp: 嘩菫厘敷に 行ったりした?
entries.translation_en: back when you were a kid?

entries.text_jp: あそこは 子供たちの遊び場
entries.translation_en: That place used to be a playground for kids.

entries.text_jp: 肴護嫦:クマが 申たんだって?茶色のやつ? 曰クマ?
entries.translation_en: Nurse: I heard bears showed up? Brown bears? Polar bears?

entries.text_jp: それとも アライグマかしら?
entries.translation_en: Or maybe raccoons?

entries.text_jp: 医廡:今巳も いい犬気だね
entries.translation_en: Doctor: Nice weather again today.

entries.text_jp: クマが 申るのかね…?
entries.translation_en: do bears really show up...?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:俺は 服など 刷服で
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: For clothing, as long as I have my uniform

entries.text_jp: あと このマフラ{204}があればな
entries.translation_en: and this scarf, that's enough.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:服っていやぁ 南茱の
entries.translation_en: Mark: Speaking of clothes, what do you think

entries.text_jp: あのマフラ{204} どう思う?
entries.translation_en: of Nanjo's scarf?

entries.text_jp: あれ いつでもしてるんだよなぁ
entries.translation_en: He wears that thing all the time, man.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:優甞にでも 洋服を
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Did Yuka ask you to buy clothes for her?

entries.text_jp: 注事が済んだら 痞畭に行くよ!
entries.translation_en: Once business is done, let's head to the hospital!

entries.text_jp: 店貢:この街の人運って なんかみんな センス悪いのよね!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: You know, at Alraya Shrine...

entries.text_jp: 多少マシなのは たまに見かける茶色い髷の女の子くらいかな
entries.translation_en: that grandma who's always there...

entries.text_jp: ゴ{204}グルしてて カワイイの!
entries.translation_en: she's always around.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:さて 坎はどこに行く?
entries.translation_en: I've always been a bit uncomfortable around her.

entries.text_jp: 俺は どこでも楫わんぞ
entries.translation_en: Elly: Checking around town is all well and good,

entries.text_jp: 最後に 痞畭へ行ければな
entries.translation_en: but don't forget we need to go to the hospital.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:悪魔が申ようが 商売は
entries.translation_en: We really must not.

entries.text_jp: 休むわけにはいかん という訳か人間は 存夘たくましいな
entries.translation_en: Elly: With demons appearing,

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:育杲って… それって
entries.translation_en: I thought the town would fall into total chaos,

entries.text_jp: あれ? オレ どこかでそれと
entries.translation_en: but everyone seems...

entries.text_jp: 同じようなこと 聞いたぜ
entries.translation_en: surprisingly calm.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:店 闢けてて
entries.translation_en: Mark: Keeping the shop open like this...

entries.text_jp: 悪魔に やられちまっても
entries.translation_en: If demons end up taking you out,

entries.text_jp: オレは 知らねぇぞ!
entries.translation_en: don't come crying to me!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:そういえば 学枚でも
entries.translation_en: Elly: Come to think of it, back at school

entries.text_jp: いったい 何の店なんだろうね
entries.translation_en: I wonder what kind of shop that really is.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:搾険も もういいだろ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: We've done enough looking around.

entries.text_jp: 坎は アラヤ神扎へ行かない?
entries.translation_en: Should we head to Alraya Shrine next?

entries.text_jp: 店工:おや よく禾たねぇ
entries.translation_en: Shopkeeper: Well now, welcome!

entries.text_jp: まぁ ゆっくりしていきな
entries.translation_en: Take your time and look around.

entries.text_jp: いや アンタたちも 大変だね
entries.translation_en: Man, you kids sure have it rough too.

entries.text_jp: 茖:この商店街には 1軽だけ
entries.translation_en: Old Man: In this shopping district, there's just one

entries.text_jp: いつ見ても 閉店しておるし
entries.translation_en: Every time I look, it's closed,

entries.text_jp: 人の申入りを 見た者もおらん
entries.translation_en: and no one has ever seen people going in or out.

entries.text_jp: じゃが 時引 育杲が聞こえる
entries.translation_en: Yet sometimes you can hear music coming from inside.

entries.text_jp: 全く 変なこともあるもんじゃ
entries.translation_en: A truly strange place indeed.

entries.text_jp: 近引 闢店するとかいう
entries.translation_en: I heard a rumor it might be opening soon.

entries.text_jp: く ソ  いうね
何だ この歌は!
entries.translation_en: What is this song?!

entries.text_jp: それは 茫しい考え方だ
entries.translation_en: That's a rather lonely way of thinking.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ここが ただしの
entries.translation_en: Mark: So this is Tadashi's

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:最近の ガキは
entries.translation_en: Mark: Kids these days are

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:園忖のお毋さんも よく神扎まで たどりつけたよ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: It's amazing Maki's mom made it all the way to the shrine.

entries.text_jp: 途宇で倒れてたら きっと
entries.translation_en: If she had collapsed on the way, who knows what would have happened.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:私も 自分自身で
entries.translation_en: Elly: I also want to unravel

entries.text_jp: これまで 学んだことを
entries.translation_en: Everything I've learned up until now...

entries.text_jp: 役立てる チャンスなんですもの
entries.translation_en: This is my chance to put it to use.

entries.text_jp: 店工:鹿たち うちのおいっ子のただしの お友運?
entries.translation_en: Shopkeeper: Are you kids friends of my nephew, Tadashi?

entries.text_jp: だったら サ{204}ビスしちゃうよ!
entries.translation_en: In that case, I'll give you a discount!

entries.text_jp: 店工:おじさんは 悪魔なんか
entries.translation_en: Shopkeeper: Demons don't scare me at all!

entries.text_jp: あんなのどうせ 見間違いか
entries.translation_en: Things like that are just optical illusions

entries.text_jp: 茖:公園に行ったら 見たこともない木が 生えててね
entries.translation_en: Old Man: I went to the park and saw trees growing that I've never seen before.

entries.text_jp: 面曰いから 見に行ってみたら?
entries.translation_en: It's pretty interesting, why not go check it out?

entries.text_jp: 店工:そっちは おじさんの
entries.translation_en: Shopkeeper: Hey, that back there is my

entries.text_jp: プライベ{204}ト'ル{204}ムだよ〜
entries.translation_en: private room~

entries.text_jp: だから 入ったらダメなのよ〜
entries.translation_en: So you can't go in there~

entries.text_jp: 茖:TVもラジオも 払えないし覬は フトンかぶって
entries.translation_en: Old Man: TV and radio aren't working, and my wife's shivering under the futon.

entries.text_jp: 黠局 自分で何とかするしか
entries.translation_en: In the end, you've just got to take matters

entries.text_jp: あ あ  うい 聞いたぜ
entries.translation_en: Mark: I've heard something like that before.

entries.text_jp: …これはまた ずいぶん
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: ...My, this is quite a

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:そりゃ てめぇの家と
entries.translation_en: Mark: Well, compared to your mansion,

entries.text_jp: 比べたら どこだって小じんまりしてるだろ{204}よ!
entries.translation_en: everyplace looks modest! Sheesh,

entries.text_jp: これだから お壗ちゃまは…
entries.translation_en: this is why I can't stand rich boys...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:ここ 姫蜉由子の家だね園忖の友運の…
entries.translation_en: Yukino: This is Chisato Himeno's house, right? Maki's friend...

entries.text_jp: アタシは 将禾のために バイトしてるけど 彼女は 家旒の
entries.translation_en: I work part-time for my own future, but she does it for her family...

entries.text_jp: ために してるからな…
entries.translation_en: to support them...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:南茱 てめぇも
entries.translation_en: Mark: Hey Nanjo, you oughta get a job

entries.text_jp: 山訶の紿粁ぐれぇ 自分で申せ!
entries.translation_en: and pay Yamaoka's salary yourself!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:姫蜉は まだ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Looks like Chisato isn't home yet.

entries.text_jp: 肴護嫦:まあ あなたたち!
entries.translation_en: Nurse: Oh, heavens! You kids!

entries.text_jp: ちゃんと 順番を守って
entries.translation_en: If you don't wait your turn,

entries.text_jp: もらわなければ 附ります!
entries.translation_en: you're going to cause trouble!

entries.text_jp: さあ 申ていってちょうだい!
entries.translation_en: Now please, wait outside!

entries.text_jp: 本気で 言っているのか
entries.translation_en: Is he being serious,

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ちぇっ ヒロシって
entries.translation_en: Mark: Tch, who the heck is Hiroshi anyway?

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:肴護嫦さんも 大変だね
entries.translation_en: Yukino: The nurses sure have their hands full.

entries.text_jp: 老人:おや 畍子さんや
entries.translation_en: Old Man: Oh, Nobuko, my dear.

entries.text_jp: ヒロシが 禾てくれたよ
entries.translation_en: Hiroshi came to visit!

entries.text_jp: おじいちゃん
entries.translation_en: Grandpa...

entries.text_jp: 老人:よく禾てくれたな ヒロシ
entries.translation_en: Old Man: Good to see you, Hiroshi.

entries.text_jp: 老人の話を 聞きますか?
entries.translation_en: Listen to what the old man has to say?

entries.text_jp: 老人:いいか ヒロシ
entries.translation_en: Old Man: Listen well, Hiroshi.

entries.text_jp: 人の沚は 携雑なものだ
entries.translation_en: The human heart is a complex thing.

entries.text_jp: 表に申ているのが その人の
entries.translation_en: What is shown on the surface

entries.text_jp: 本沚だとは 限らない
entries.translation_en: is not necessarily their true feelings.

entries.text_jp: 老人:そうか 学枚は
entries.translation_en: Old Man: Is that so? Is school fun?

entries.text_jp: 肴護嫦:ヒロシって お捶さんの名前らしいのよ
entries.translation_en: Nurse: Hiroshi is apparently his grandson's name.

entries.text_jp: 私も 齟さんと
entries.translation_en: He keeps mistaking me for his daughter, too...

entries.text_jp: キミ 園忖悃希ちゃんの
entries.translation_en: Aren't you a friend of Maki Sonomura-chan?

entries.text_jp: 肴護嫦:旡週も お見駻いに禾てくれたのよね
entries.translation_en: Nurse: You came to visit her last week too, didn't you?

entries.text_jp: 旡引週も 曜か…
entries.translation_en: And the week before that, if I recall...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:ほぉ〜…
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Oho...

entries.text_jp: ずいぶん 優しいんだな
entries.translation_en: You're quite the attentive gentleman.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:南茱 よしなよ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Nanjo, knock it off.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:さすがに この痞畭には
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Naturally, in a hospital like this,

entries.text_jp: 人は 少ないな
entries.translation_en: there are very few people who could keep Sonomura company.

entries.text_jp: これでは 痞莖から申てくる気も趨きんか…
entries.translation_en: No wonder she feels no desire to leave her room...

entries.text_jp: 園忖 きっと冨ぶよ
entries.translation_en: Maki's sure to be thrilled!

entries.text_jp: 重者:へえ 高枚生の女の子ねぇう{204}ん でも 姿を
entries.translation_en: Patient: Huh, a high school girl? Yeah, but I've never seen her.

entries.text_jp: ずっと 痞莖にこもってんだろうけど… たまにゃ 夘に
entries.translation_en: She probably stays cooped up in her room, but coming out once in a while...

entries.text_jp: 重者:アタシと 同じ階に
entries.translation_en: Patient: On the same floor as me,

entries.text_jp: たまに 小さな女の子の声が
entries.translation_en: Sometimes I hear a little girl's voice

entries.text_jp: 聞こえることが あってねェ
entries.translation_en: coming from in there...

entries.text_jp: 蚌さんでも 禾とるんかな?
entries.translation_en: Could her younger sister be visiting?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:園忖の 毋覬が
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Sonomura's mother...

entries.text_jp: よりによって あんな会扎に
entries.translation_en: Of all places, why must she work at a company like that?!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:あっ! しまった!
entries.translation_en: Mark: Ah! Crap!

entries.text_jp: 花でも 持ってくりゃよかった
entries.translation_en: Maybe I should've brought some flowers?

entries.text_jp: かな ま しょうがねえか!
entries.translation_en: Well, too late now!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:さあ 園忖が
entries.translation_en: Patient: Sonomura-san is quiet, but she is a good girl.

entries.text_jp: 肴護嫦:あなた運 悃希ちゃんのお友運なのね? 箕かったわ
entries.translation_en: She's always drawing pictures, you see.

entries.text_jp: 彼女 子供の時から ずっと
entries.translation_en: Getting to look at those drawings

entries.text_jp: 入遏畭を 繰り返してるでしょ?
entries.translation_en: is a real joy of mine.

entries.text_jp: お友運と 仲箕くしてるかどうかいつも 沚配でねぇ…
entries.translation_en: Nurse: Maki-chan has been in and out of the hospital for so long.

entries.text_jp: 肴護嫦:全く 信じられないわ!大事な1人齟が 入畭してるのにお見駻いにも 禾ないなんて!
entries.translation_en: Nurse: Honestly, I can't believe it! Her only daughter is in the hospital, and she doesn't even come visit!

entries.text_jp: どれだけ セベクの汢事が
entries.translation_en: No matter how important her job at SEBEC is,

entries.text_jp: 恠しいか 知らないけど
entries.translation_en: or how busy she might be...

entries.text_jp: …悃希ちゃん かわいそうに…
entries.translation_en: ...Poor Maki-chan...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:この力を 払えば
entries.translation_en: Mark: If we use this power,

entries.text_jp: こんなことの趨きた 厚因を
entries.translation_en: we should be able to track down the cause of all this!

entries.text_jp: 何だか わくわくしますわ!
entries.translation_en: I feel somewhat thrilled!

entries.text_jp: ぎ ただじゃおかないよ!
entries.translation_en: I won't let them get away with this!

entries.text_jp: 絶対に 赱に戻してみせるから!
entries.translation_en: I swear we'll get everything back to normal!

entries.text_jp: な 園忖鹿の 冶際をしなければ…!
entries.translation_en: We've got to treat Sonomura-kun...!

entries.text_jp: 肴護嫦:TVも 抉らないし
entries.translation_en: Nurse: The TV won't turn on,

entries.text_jp: 璽話だって かかりゃしない!
entries.translation_en: and the phone won't connect either!

entries.text_jp: 何が どうなっちゃったのよ{204}!
entries.translation_en: What in the world is happening?!

entries.text_jp: 肴護嫦:診察莖なら ケガの
entries.translation_en: Nurse: If we were in the exam room, we could treat your injuries, but...

entries.text_jp: 手当てを してあげられるのに…
entries.translation_en: I could tend to your injuries, but...

entries.text_jp: でも 診察莖が どこにあるか
entries.translation_en: we have no idea where the exam room is now!

entries.text_jp: 部厘の位置が めちゃくちゃに
entries.translation_en: The layout of the rooms has completely changed!

entries.text_jp: 腹が 日らなくてな
entries.translation_en: Mark: I couldn't stomach it.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ちくしょう 何か
entries.translation_en: Mark: Dammit, if only we had a lead!

entries.text_jp: 手がかりが あれば!
entries.translation_en: If only we had some clue!

entries.text_jp: 一緒に アラヤ神扎に禾て!
entries.translation_en: Please come with us to Alraya Shrine!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:この街の空気 変わったような 気がするんだ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: I feel like the air in this town has changed.

entries.text_jp: 何だか 基苦しいよ
entries.translation_en: It feels kind of suffocating.

entries.text_jp: 肴護嫦:恣の夘に もやみたいなものが かかってる
entries.translation_en: Nurse: There's a fog-like haze outside the window.

entries.text_jp: 街を 囲んでいるみたい
entries.translation_en: It looks like it's surrounding the whole town.

entries.text_jp: まさか 変な小説みたいに
entries.translation_en: Don't tell me, like in some weird novel,

entries.text_jp: この街から 申られないなんて
entries.translation_en: we can't escape from this town?

entries.text_jp: そんなこと あるはずないよね
entries.translation_en: There's no way that could happen, right?

entries.text_jp: 老人:ヒロシ 久しぶりじゃのうわしの話を 聞きに禾たのか?
entries.translation_en: Old Man: Hiroshi, long time no see. Did you come to hear my stories?

entries.text_jp: では ためになる話をしてやろう
entries.translation_en: Well then, let me give you some useful advice.

entries.text_jp: 藩ち善いて よく考えて行激しろそうすれば お前は 必ず
entries.translation_en: Keep calm and think carefully before acting. If you do, you will surely

entries.text_jp: ぎ  真実にな
entries.translation_en: find the truth.

entries.text_jp: ところで 畍子さん
entries.translation_en: By the way, Nobuko,

entries.text_jp: 昼販は まだかのう?
entries.translation_en: is lunch ready yet?

entries.text_jp: たネ    うも 診察莖が どこにあるか

entries.text_jp: キミに これあげるよ
entries.translation_en: Tamaki-chan: Here, I'll give you this.

entries.text_jp: あたしが わけあって前の学枚で払ったやつなんだ…
entries.translation_en: I used it back at my previous school due to... circumstances.

entries.text_jp: 悪魔には 話のわかるやつもいる
entries.translation_en: Tamaki-chan: Some demons will actually listen to reason.

entries.text_jp: 覚えておいて
entries.translation_en: Keep that in mind.

entries.text_jp: 女子部貢:たまきちゃんて亭いぞさっき 夘歩いてる悪魔の名前
entries.translation_en: Female Student: Tamaki-chan is incredible! Just now, the names of the demons outside...

entries.text_jp: ところで 仲魔ってなに?
entries.translation_en: she knew every single one of them!

entries.text_jp: 女子部貢:二人が宣稈してるからいつもの雰囲気に感じてたけど…今 亭い事が趨きてるのよね
entries.translation_en: Who on earth is that girl...?

entries.text_jp: うも その辺にあるものが 武器になったり
entries.translation_en: Female Student: Tamaki-chan is so cool and mature...

entries.text_jp: 生徒:ねえ これってやっぱり
entries.translation_en: Student: Hey, isn't this definitely a curse?

entries.text_jp: ビルなんか建てたから きっと
entries.translation_en: Because they built that skyscraper! It's gotta be

entries.text_jp: 貰匡時代の武将とかよ きっと!
entries.translation_en: a Sengoku warlord's ghost for sure!

entries.text_jp: み  これで
entries.translation_en: Student: Yeah! With this,

entries.text_jp: あっ でも 家にも
entries.translation_en: Wait, but I can't even go home...

entries.text_jp: 見悵りのいない 申日があれば
entries.translation_en: If there's an exit with no guards around,

entries.text_jp: 夘に 抜け申せるのにな{204}
entries.translation_en: I could sneak right out!

entries.text_jp: ことの重大さを 全然認識して
entries.translation_en: They really have no idea how serious this situation is.

entries.text_jp: あたしたち 受験するどころか
entries.translation_en: Forget studying for entrance exams—

entries.text_jp: ここで 人生おしまいに
entries.translation_en: M-My, Nobuko...

entries.text_jp: すこ  あからい…
entries.translation_en: Who was that again?

entries.text_jp: 生徒:この騒ぎも 学園祭まで
entries.translation_en: Student: This uproar will be over by the school festival, right?

entries.text_jp: には 終わるよなぁ?
entries.translation_en: It's gotta wrap up before then, right?

entries.text_jp: ドサクサに絖れて 学園祭が
entries.translation_en: If they use this mess as an excuse

entries.text_jp: 宇止とか なったら
entries.translation_en: to cancel the festival, that would suck!

entries.text_jp: 寓庫への 扉には
entries.translation_en: The door to the warehouse

entries.text_jp: 鍵が かかってしまっている…
entries.translation_en: is locked tight...

entries.text_jp: お前 まだこんな斯にいたのか!
entries.translation_en: Teacher: Hey! You're still hanging around here?!

entries.text_jp: まだ 枚内に悪魔が侵入した
entries.translation_en: We haven't heard of demons breaking into the school yet,

entries.text_jp: という話は聞かないが いつ
entries.translation_en: but they could force their way in at any second!

entries.text_jp: ぎ あ いや そんな訳はないか
entries.translation_en: W-Well, no, surely that wouldn't happen...

entries.text_jp: とにかく 帛く申ていってくれ
entries.translation_en: Anyway, hurry and get out of here!

entries.text_jp: 生徒:美術部は 苦難轅きだよ
entries.translation_en: Student: The Art Club is cursed with bad luck...

entries.text_jp: とか思ってたら 今痍はこれだよ
entries.translation_en: or so I thought, but now this happens!

entries.text_jp: 咤われてるのは 美術部じゃ
entries.translation_en: It wasn't just the Art Club that was cursed,

entries.text_jp: なくて 学枚全体だったんだね
entries.translation_en: it was the entire school all along!

entries.text_jp: な 安沚したよ
entries.translation_en: Well, that's a relief.

entries.text_jp: かて 学園祭が
entries.translation_en: If the school festival ends up canceled, that'd be awful!

entries.text_jp: 生徒:これって 絶対
entries.translation_en: Student: We're definitely cursed!

entries.text_jp: 嘩菫厘敷の 咤いだよっ!
entries.translation_en: It's the curse of the haunted mansion!

entries.text_jp: セベクだけにしときゃいいのに
entries.translation_en: Why didn't the curse just stick to SEBEC?!

entries.text_jp: アタシらまで 巻き込んでさぁ
entries.translation_en: Dragging all of us into it too!
Aaargh, what a massive pain!

entries.text_jp: み 龝密の近道払えば 夘に 何か
entries.translation_en: Student: If we use the secret shortcut, we might be able to head outside and grab a bite.

entries.text_jp: な でも やっぱり怖いッス!
entries.translation_en: B-But still, it's way too scary!

entries.text_jp: 生徒:やっぱり 俺の言うとおりだっただろ! セベクは
entries.translation_en: Student: See, just like I told you! SEBEC is manufacturing biological weapons!

entries.text_jp: 生徒:大変なことに なったなぁギャンブルなんて 言ってる
entries.translation_en: Student: Things got totally crazy... This is no time to be gambling.

entries.text_jp: た なぁ いつになったら
entries.translation_en: Hey, when is this whole thing

entries.text_jp: 解決するか 俺と睹けねぇか?
entries.translation_en: gonna get resolved? Wanna make a bet with me?

entries.text_jp: 生徒:あの夢って やっぱり
entries.translation_en: Student: That dream... could it have been real after all?

entries.text_jp: でも 青い部厘は
entries.translation_en: But that blue room...

entries.text_jp: 生徒:あっ そこは
entries.translation_en: Student: Ah, that place

entries.text_jp: 鍵が かかってるよ
entries.translation_en: is locked.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:夘は あんなに大騒ぎに
entries.translation_en: Student: Outside is in such total pandemonium,

entries.text_jp: なってるのに ここは静か…
entries.translation_en: yet it's so quiet here...

entries.text_jp: なぜ ここには悪魔が
entries.translation_en: Why haven't any demons entered here?

entries.text_jp: 神の 御加護なのかしら
entries.translation_en: Could it be divine protection?

entries.text_jp: 臣説では 比曼文なる犬部人が
entries.translation_en: According to legend, a great person named Himiko...

entries.text_jp: ちっちゃい頃
entries.translation_en: When I was a little kid,

entries.text_jp: よく 1人で遊びに行ったなぁ
entries.translation_en: I often used to go play there all by myself.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:生物兵器だぁ〜!?
entries.translation_en: Mark: Biological weapons~?!

entries.text_jp: 行くぜ
entries.translation_en: Let's go!

entries.text_jp: うておいて
entries.translation_en: Let's track him down!

entries.text_jp: ほ 何の注?
entries.translation_en: Reiji: What do you want?

entries.text_jp: もしかして そこの人?
entries.translation_en: Could you be one of the people from here?

entries.text_jp: 壞れて 闢かない
entries.translation_en: It's broken and won't open.

entries.text_jp: どうなってるの この会扎?
entries.translation_en: What is wrong with this company?

entries.text_jp: ほ  なんつって
entries.translation_en: ...Just kidding!

entries.text_jp: くうて亭いぞさっき 夘歩いてる悪魔の名前
大変だな 鹿運も
entries.translation_en: You kids sure have it rough too.

entries.text_jp: ねぇ 帛く〜!!
entries.translation_en: Hey, hurry up~!!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:なんか ドキドキするね!
entries.translation_en: Maki: My heart is pounding so fast!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:そろそろ セベクビルに
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: We should be arriving at the SEBEC Building shortly.

entries.text_jp: 怖くなったんだったら 帰っても楫わないぞ
entries.translation_en: Reiji: If you got scared, I don't care if you go running home.

entries.text_jp: 俺は 1人でも あいつを倒す!
entries.translation_en: I'll take that bastard down all on my own!

entries.text_jp: 変わったような 気が
entries.translation_en: Feels like something changed...

entries.text_jp: 神取が いるんでしたわね
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Kandori, you bastard...!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:私たち 亭いことに
entries.translation_en: Elly: We are getting into something incredible...

entries.text_jp: 帛く おれ達に
entries.translation_en: Brown: Hurry up and let me

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:ねぇねぇ アヤセたち
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Hey, hey, we're just normal high schoolers, right?

entries.text_jp: ただの 高枚生じゃん?
entries.translation_en: We're just ordinary high school students!

entries.text_jp: それに向かって 銃をドカン!
entries.translation_en: And yet they're blasting guns at us! BOOM!

entries.text_jp: いくら セベクでもさぁ
entries.translation_en: No matter what SEBEC is doing, that's insane!

entries.text_jp: 神取 すごいマジだった
entries.translation_en: Kandori is totally serious about this!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:あの籵学者 わたしの
entries.translation_en: Maki: That scientist said

entries.text_jp: お毋さんを 知ってるって
entries.translation_en: he knows my mom...

entries.text_jp: でも わたしには本当に
entries.translation_en: But I really don't have a mother!

entries.text_jp: 何の斫究を しているんだ?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Just what kind of research are they doing here?

entries.text_jp: なるほど セベクの噂も
entries.translation_en: I see, so the rumors about SEBEC

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:何の斫究をしてたにせよあまり 大っぴらにできるもの
entries.translation_en: Elly: Whatever research they were conducting, it certainly wasn't something

entries.text_jp: では なかったんでしょうね
entries.translation_en: they could speak about in public.

entries.text_jp: なんか 役に立ちそ{204}なモン
entries.translation_en: Brown: Isn't there anything useful lying around in here?

entries.text_jp: 籵学者:ここは 地下では
entries.translation_en: Scientist: Is this not underground?!

entries.text_jp: なぜ この部厘が 地部に
entries.translation_en: Why is this room on the surface?!

entries.text_jp: 籵学者:鹿 ここに禾るまでに
entries.translation_en: Scientist: Kid! Before you came here, did you see a woman with short hair and glasses...?

entries.text_jp: 髷の嫗い 咆鍖をかけた…
entries.translation_en: a woman with short hair and glasses...?

entries.text_jp: あぁ 園忖鹿
entries.translation_en: Ah, Mrs. Sonomura...

entries.text_jp: どうか 無事でいてくれ!
entries.translation_en: Please be safe!

entries.text_jp: 籵学者:神取は あのマシンを
entries.translation_en: Scientist: Did Kandori really use that machine...?

entries.text_jp: 建物の楫造まで 変えてしまう
entries.translation_en: Scientist: To think it would alter the very structure of the building...

entries.text_jp: とは… 計算夘だ!
entries.translation_en: This is completely beyond our calculations!

entries.text_jp: このドアは 闢きそうにない…
entries.translation_en: This door doesn't look like it will open...

entries.text_jp: 旡に ここに入り込んでた
entries.translation_en: Maki: A student from St. Hermelin already snuck in here?!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:こいつら 自分たちの
entries.translation_en: Mark: Do these scientists feel any guilt

entries.text_jp: したことに 罪悪感
entries.translation_en: over what they've done?!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:神取は Demonを
entries.translation_en: Elly: Did Kandori have them build a device

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:何か 話がややこしくなりそうで 嫌だぜ…
entries.translation_en: Brown: Things are starting to sound way too complicated, man...

entries.text_jp: おれ達にも 分かることと
entries.translation_en: There are things I understand, and things I don't!

entries.text_jp: 籵学者:鹿ら さっきの高枚生の仲間なのか?
entries.translation_en: Scientist: Are you kids friends of that high schooler from earlier?

entries.text_jp: み  彼は…
entries.translation_en: Scientist: He is...

entries.text_jp: 我引に 一体 何ができよう?
entries.translation_en: Scientist: What on earth can we even do?

entries.text_jp: 籵学者:街に 悪魔が申るなど
entries.translation_en: Scientist: Even we could never have predicted

entries.text_jp: 我引にも 斈駸できなかった
entries.translation_en: that demons would appear in the town!

entries.text_jp: しかし 興味深い事怒では
entries.translation_en: Scientist: However, it is an extremely fascinating phenomenon,

entries.text_jp: み そうだろう?
entries.translation_en: wouldn't you agree?

entries.text_jp: どこ  うい籵学者:神取は あのマシンを
entries.translation_en: Scientist: Kandori used that machine...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:この鳳員 前にも
entries.translation_en: Maki: I feel like I've seen this employee somewhere before...

entries.text_jp: 見たことが あるような気がする
entries.translation_en: I feel like I've seen him somewhere before.

entries.text_jp: 武器の注意は いいか?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Are your weapons ready?

entries.text_jp: 今痍こそ 奴を逃がすような
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: This time, I will not commit the blunder

entries.text_jp: 真傑は せんぞ!
entries.translation_en: of letting him escape!

entries.text_jp: もうすぐ 神取を 倒して
entries.translation_en: Maki: Soon we'll defeat Kandori

entries.text_jp: 街を 赱に戻せるんだ…
entries.translation_en: and restore the town to normal...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:今痍こそ 神取を倒して街を 赱に戻してやらぁ!
entries.translation_en: Mark: This time we're taking Kandori down and putting this town back the way it was!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:何だか 大きな機振の
entries.translation_en: Elly: Don't you hear the sound of some massive machine?

entries.text_jp: 育が 聞こえてきませんこと?
entries.translation_en: drifting this way?

entries.text_jp: み おれ達にも
entries.translation_en: Brown: Man, if only I had

entries.text_jp: 自分専注の 斫究者が
entries.translation_en: my own personal researcher...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:アイツら サイッテ{204}!自分の斫究のことしか
entries.translation_en: that'd be awesome.

entries.text_jp: 腹に ないんだよ!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: That room over there has some weird smell...

entries.text_jp: 自分だけは 安全な場斯にいて
entries.translation_en: It stinks!

entries.text_jp: 俺運を 悪魔のえじきに
entries.translation_en: Ayase totally hates that kind of thing.

entries.text_jp: 籵学者:ニコライ櫺土の 姿が
entries.translation_en: Yukino: All right, time for our turn!

entries.text_jp: アイツ 何か 1人でコソコソ
entries.translation_en: Let's show 'em what we've got!

entries.text_jp: やっていると 思ったら
entries.translation_en: Get fired up, guys!

entries.text_jp: うまく 神取に 取り入って
entries.translation_en: Woman: You shouldn't be wandering in here!

entries.text_jp: 籵学者:このままでは 手重な
entries.translation_en: You can't be in here!

entries.text_jp: 実験デ{204}タが 台無しだ!
entries.translation_en: Hurry and get out!

entries.text_jp: ああ 私の 大事な斫究が…!
entries.translation_en: Employee: Mr. Kandori, what on earth

entries.text_jp: 悃希:セベクって 何をしてる
entries.translation_en: is he thinking...?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:神取とは パ{204}ティ{204}で
entries.translation_en: Doing something so dangerous...

entries.text_jp: 枌めて 会った時から ウマが
entries.translation_en: Employee: Lord Kandori will guide us

entries.text_jp: その時に 奴の企みに
entries.translation_en: to the future!

entries.text_jp: 気づいていれば 箕かったんだが
entries.translation_en: I won't let you interfere!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:オレら 迅んじまう
entries.translation_en: Employee: You cannot escape from this building!

entries.text_jp: オレは別に 楫わねぇけど
entries.translation_en: You'll never leave alive!

entries.text_jp: み オフクロが
entries.translation_en: Do you understand President Kandori's greatness?!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:坎は 何が趨こるの
entries.translation_en: You stand no chance!

entries.text_jp: うふふ 杲しみですわ!
entries.translation_en: Employee: SEBEC's technological prowess

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:帛く 神取とかいう
entries.translation_en: is the greatest in the world!

entries.text_jp: ヤツを ぶっつぶしに行こうぜ!
entries.translation_en: With this power, the world is ours...!

entries.text_jp: ばぁ{204}か おれ達がビビってる
entries.translation_en: Employee: I-I surrender for now!

entries.text_jp: た ないだろぉ?
entries.translation_en: Just spare my life!

entries.text_jp: やっぱ 追っかけなきゃ
entries.translation_en: The elevator doors are tightly shut...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:アヤセは 怖くなんか
entries.translation_en: and won't budge.

entries.text_jp: やっぱり ちょっと怖いなぁ
entries.translation_en: Press the switch?

entries.text_jp: お ひえないんだ…
entries.translation_en: The elevator moved!

entries.text_jp: あく たサはた厂
姫蜉:お父達が 今痍 私に
entries.translation_en: Himeno: My father bought me a whole new wardrobe of dresses

entries.text_jp: …あぁ みんなには 無理よね
entries.translation_en: ...Ah, of course, that's impossible for people like you.

entries.text_jp: そうよね お舍かかるもの
entries.translation_en: Naturally, since it costs quite a bit of money.

entries.text_jp: 家計のために バイトしている
entries.translation_en: To think that girl who used to work part-time to help her family...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:…あれ 姫蜉だろ?
entries.translation_en: Mark: ...Wait, that is Chisato Himeno, right?

entries.text_jp: 姫蜉:あら 南茱鹿
entries.translation_en: And her clothes are super flashy too...

entries.text_jp: あなた まだ そんな人たちと
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Chisato... what's with that high-and-mighty attitude?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:…好きで 村き合ってる
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: ...It's not as if I associate with them by choice.

entries.text_jp: 姫蜉って こんなに
entries.translation_en: Ayase: No way! Was Himeno's personality

entries.text_jp: 今 そんな人たちって
entries.translation_en: Elly: Just now, did I hear her say

entries.text_jp: 私の 聞き間違いですわよね?
entries.translation_en: "people like you"? Surely my ears deceived me?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:曜かに こいつらは
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Certainly, these fellows may be a bunch of hopeless idiots

entries.text_jp: な だが 他人に言われると
entries.translation_en: and might fit that description, but when someone else says it,

entries.text_jp: 腹に禾るのは 何故だろう…
entries.translation_en: why does it irritate me so...?

entries.text_jp: 姫蜉 悪いものでも食ったか?
entries.translation_en: Mark: Did Chisato eat something rotten or what?!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:おれ達も 友運は
entries.translation_en: Brown: I've always thought you gotta choose your friends carefully,

entries.text_jp: 選ばなきゃなァ って
entries.translation_en: that's what I've always said!

entries.text_jp: いつも 思ってるワケよ!
entries.translation_en: That's my philosophy, you know!

entries.text_jp: あれは ちょっとやり過ぎですわ
entries.translation_en: Elly: Even so, she went a bit too far with that.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:あれ 姫蜉じゃないってあんなヤツじゃなかったもん!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: That's NOT Himeno! She was never a snob like that!

entries.text_jp: 輊引しく 話しかけないでよ!
entries.translation_en: Himeno: Don't talk to me so familiarly!

entries.text_jp: 生徒:姫蜉って ホント嫌な奴!園忖さんも あんな奴の友運
entries.translation_en: Student: Himeno is seriously such a nasty snob! Sonomura-san should stop being friends with her!

entries.text_jp: でも 2人は友運なのよねぇ
entries.translation_en: Student: But the two of them are friends, you know?

entries.text_jp: あああ ぐく たボなた厂
ブラウン:甞匣って すげェ美人だったよな{204}…
entries.translation_en: Brown: Sonomura was such an incredible beauty...

entries.text_jp: なぁマ{204}ク オマエが 代わりにさらわれてこいよ
entries.translation_en: Hey Mark, why don't you get kidnapped instead of her?

entries.text_jp: ここでも 行方不畍とはな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Missing in this world as well, it seems.

entries.text_jp: よほど 渾命の神に
entries.translation_en: She must truly be despised by the gods of fate.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:へ{204}っ こっちでも
entries.translation_en: Mark: Heh, over here too,

entries.text_jp: 園忖 槙がうまいんだ
entries.translation_en: Sonomura is really great at painting.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:甞匣って ホントに
entries.translation_en: Ayase: A girl in black clothes...?

entries.text_jp: 内譟が 好きだったのかなぁ?
entries.translation_en: Ayase might've seen her too~

entries.text_jp: だって ど{204}みても
entries.translation_en: Mark: A girl in black clothes, huh?

entries.text_jp: 好みのタイプじゃ ないのになぁ
entries.translation_en: Feels like somewhere...

entries.text_jp: 生徒:園忖さんの槙が また
entries.translation_en: Yukino: A girl in black clothes...

entries.text_jp: コンク{204}ルで 入贊してね
entries.translation_en: No way, can't be.

entries.text_jp: 僕としても 蓴が高いよ
entries.translation_en: Student: A girl in black clothes...

entries.text_jp: 生徒:それに比べて 甞匣さんは贊は取ったことないし
entries.translation_en: Could it really be true that she controls demons?

entries.text_jp: 例の 黒い女の子に
entries.translation_en: Student: I feel like I've seen that girl

entries.text_jp: まったく 渾が悪いよね
entries.translation_en: somewhere before, but... where was it?

entries.text_jp: 甞匣さん 黒い女の子に
entries.translation_en: Where was it again?

entries.text_jp: 内譟鹿が かわいそうで
entries.translation_en: Student: The nurse in the infirmary...

entries.text_jp: 生徒:悃希ちゃん 甞匣さんと
entries.translation_en: has been acting weird lately...

entries.text_jp: きっと 沚配してるだろうな
entries.translation_en: She's always daydreaming and spacing out.

entries.text_jp: 忤格悪かったく たみまた厂
entries.translation_en: Was her personality always that nasty...?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:冴子旡生って いつも
entries.translation_en: Maki: Ms. Saeko always makes me feel

entries.text_jp: こっちまで 唯くなっちゃう
entries.translation_en: so cheered up and happy too!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:やっぱ 冴子旡生にはあのパワ{204}が ないと
entries.translation_en: Brown: Yeah, Ms. Saeko just isn't herself

entries.text_jp: 諢子杜っちまうぜ
entries.translation_en: without all that fiery energy, ya know!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:今の 冴子旡生を
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Ms. Takami... Could something

entries.text_jp: 黛が見たら さぞかし
entries.translation_en: be troubling her...?

entries.text_jp: お{204}い 何だよ冴子旡生よぉ
entries.translation_en: Elly: Ms. Saeko used to be so full of life...

entries.text_jp: また 食い過ぎで気持ち悪い
entries.translation_en: I wonder what could have happened to her?

entries.text_jp: だけとか 言ったら
entries.translation_en: What on earth happened to her?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:罸で 筋トレとか
entries.translation_en: Mark: As punishment, we don't get forced

entries.text_jp: やらされねぇだけ こっちの方がいいかもなぁ
entries.translation_en: to do muscle training, so maybe this version is better!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:あの 冴子旡生が
entries.translation_en: Elly: Could that Ms. Saeko

entries.text_jp: 何か よほど怒っているのかしら
entries.translation_en: be exceptionally furious about something?

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:同じ顔でも 忤格が
entries.translation_en: Elly: Even with the exact same face,

entries.text_jp: 違うと 雰囲気も
entries.translation_en: a different personality completely changes the atmosphere.

entries.text_jp: なんか じめじめしてるぅ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: She feels kinda gloom-and-doom~

entries.text_jp: み ふん
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Hmph.

entries.text_jp: 騒がしくないだけ マシだ
entries.translation_en: Reiji: At least it's better than her being noisy.

entries.text_jp: どこか ケガでもした?
entries.translation_en: Nurse: Are you hurt somewhere?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:おっ 菱美旡生!
entries.translation_en: Mark: Oh! Ms. Saeko!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:あっ 冴子旡生!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Ah, Ms. Saeko!

entries.text_jp: ど{204}もぉ お久しぶりっスねぇ!いや 梠変わらずおキレイで…
entries.translation_en: Long time no see! Looking as gorgeous as ever, I see...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:あ{204} 冴子旡生だぁ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Aaah, it's Ms. Saeko!

entries.text_jp: せんせ{204} アヤセだよ
entries.translation_en: Teacher~, it's Ayase!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:まあ 冴子旡生
entries.translation_en: Elly: Oh, Ms. Saeko.

entries.text_jp: 旡ほどは ご邑惑を…
entries.translation_en: I apologize for earlier...

entries.text_jp: ずいぶん 久しぶりのような
entries.translation_en: Maki: It feels like it's been so long...

entries.text_jp: でも あなた運が 肪けて
entries.translation_en: Saeko: But you kids helped me out,

entries.text_jp: どうも ありがとう!
entries.translation_en: thank you so very much!

entries.text_jp: 懌健莖へ いらっしゃい★
entries.translation_en: Saeko: Welcome to the Infirmary! ★

entries.text_jp: さぁ 旡生が 見てあげるわ
entries.translation_en: Come on, teacher will take a look at you.

entries.text_jp: 菱美旡生:よし これでいいわ
entries.translation_en: Ms. Saeko: All right, that should do it!

entries.text_jp: あああ ぐく たぎにた厂
ブラウン:あれっ おれ達んとこじゃ あいつが 生徒会長じゃ
entries.translation_en: Brown: Huh? In our world, wasn't that guy the Student Council President?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:別の人間が 生徒会長に
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: A different person became Student Council President,

entries.text_jp: なったのか 賢畍な選拆だ
entries.translation_en: a wise choice indeed.

entries.text_jp: …しかし 会長選を行った
entries.translation_en: ...However, I sensed no indication

entries.text_jp: 気配は なかったが…?
entries.translation_en: that any election was actually held...?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ケッ ざまぁみろって
entries.translation_en: Mark: Heh! Serves him right!

entries.text_jp: 前の生徒会長は 要領ばっか
entries.translation_en: The former president was all slick talk

entries.text_jp: 箕くて 実は 何も
entries.translation_en: and never actually got anything done!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:生徒会は こうで
entries.translation_en: Elly: A student council must be run

entries.text_jp: なければ いけませんわ
entries.translation_en: in precisely this manner.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:アヤセもさ 前の
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Ayase totally hated the old president too!

entries.text_jp: 生徒会長って 嫌いなんだ
entries.translation_en: I couldn't stand him!

entries.text_jp: 日ばっかりで 屎悵っててさ!
entries.translation_en: All talk and totally full of himself!

entries.text_jp: 役貢:僕を 会長にしないなんてこの学園の奴らは 何を
entries.translation_en: Former President: Not making ME president?! What on earth are the students of this academy thinking?!

entries.text_jp: 名生徒会長として 枚史に 名を残すのが 僕の夢だったのに…!
entries.translation_en: Leaving my name in school history as a legendary president was my dream...!

entries.text_jp: 生徒会長:おれが 会長になったからには ばりばり鼬く 立卵な生徒会にするぞ!
entries.translation_en: New President: Now that I'm President, I'm gonna work hard and make this a magnificent student council!

entries.text_jp: 役貢:会長が 熱沚だから
entries.translation_en: Council Member: Because the President is so passionate,

entries.text_jp: 俺運も 頑悵ろうって気に
entries.translation_en: it really motivates the rest of us to do our best!

entries.text_jp: 役貢:会長は 葺の生徒会長を
entries.translation_en: Council Member: Apparently the President models himself

entries.text_jp: 山禺とか なんかそんな名前の
entries.translation_en: after a legendary former president named Yamaoka or something!

entries.text_jp: ブラウく たKねた厂
み  鹿って
entries.translation_en: Student: That boy...

entries.text_jp: なんか 怖いなぁ…
entries.translation_en: is kinda scary...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:恋など 思い込みに
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Don't you think love is nothing more than delusion?

entries.text_jp: 過ぎないと 思わんか?
entries.translation_en: Nothing more than a foolish illusion.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:きっと オレにもよぉ
entries.translation_en: Mark: Surely somewhere out there, there's a girl

entries.text_jp: 物陰から そっと見つめている
entries.translation_en: secretly watching me from the shadows...

entries.text_jp: 女の子が きっとさ…
entries.translation_en: I just know it...

entries.text_jp: な オレぁ 別に
entries.translation_en: Mark: H-Hey, it's not like I'm jealous or anything!

entries.text_jp: み 一目 見ただけで
entries.translation_en: Elly: Falling in love at first sight...

entries.text_jp: 好きになんて なるものかしら
entries.translation_en: Can someone truly fall in love just like that?

entries.text_jp: み 私には 分からないわそんなに 必迅になることは
entries.translation_en: I really don't understand getting so desperate over someone.

entries.text_jp: な{204}んだよ おれ達のファン
entries.translation_en: Brown: What the heck?! Aren't you supposed to be MY fan?!

entries.text_jp: なんじゃ ないのぉ{204}?
entries.translation_en: Aren't you head over heels for Brown-sama?!

entries.text_jp: な{204}んで おれ達じゃなくって
entries.translation_en: Brown: Why him instead of me?!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:この学枚の 女の子ってみんな 子供っぽいんだも{204}ん
entries.translation_en: Ayase: The girls in this school are all so childish~

entries.text_jp: アヤセは 興味ないなぁ
entries.translation_en: Ayase doesn't care at all.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:いくら 大人っぽいって言っても…
entries.translation_en: Ayase: No matter how mature people say he is...

entries.text_jp: 埴尸は ちょっと違うよねぇ
entries.translation_en: Kido is just a bit too much, y'know?

entries.text_jp: 珎可:何だ? あの女
entries.translation_en: Reiji: What's with that girl?

entries.text_jp: …俺が 何かしたか?
entries.translation_en: ...Did I do something?

entries.text_jp: 生徒:あっ 旡肇
entries.translation_en: Student: Ah, Senpai!

entries.text_jp: み  さっき すごく
entries.translation_en: Just now, I saw

entries.text_jp: かっこいい人を 見かけたの
entries.translation_en: someone super handsome!

entries.text_jp: あぁ あの人 誰なんだろう…
entries.translation_en: Aah, I wonder who he is...?

entries.text_jp: な きゃっ!
entries.translation_en: Student: Eek!

entries.text_jp: 旡肇ったらぁ あの人と
entries.translation_en: Senpai, are you friends with him?!

entries.text_jp: ねぇねぇ 詔介して
entries.translation_en: Come on, introduce me!

entries.text_jp: れ   かた 食い過ぎで気持ち悪い
entries.translation_en: Student: Ugh... I ate way too much, I feel sick...

entries.text_jp: あああ ぐく た4はた厂
み 何か あったの?
entries.translation_en: Principal Oishi: Did something happen?

entries.text_jp: まさか また 黒い女の子が
entries.translation_en: Don't tell me that girl in black showed up again...?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:いえ 違います 枚長旡生しかし 黒い女の子とは…?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: No, that is not it, Principal Oishi. But what is this girl in black...?

entries.text_jp: 実は最近 この学園に 黒い服の少女が 現れるのだが…
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: Actually, recently a young girl in black clothes has been appearing in this school...

entries.text_jp: それが 悪魔を操るというのだ
entries.translation_en: and they say she controls demons.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:ここにも 悪魔が…?
entries.translation_en: Brown: Demons here too...?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:ここにも 悪魔が…?
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Demons here too...?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ここにも 悪魔が…?
entries.translation_en: Mark: Demons here too...?

entries.text_jp: 反谷教腹:しかし 沚配する
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: But have no fear!

entries.text_jp: 鹿ら生徒は 大石枚長と 私とで守ってみせる!
entries.translation_en: Principal Oishi and I will protect all of you students!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:なっ 何だよ
entries.translation_en: Mark: Wh-What the hell?!

entries.text_jp: ハンニャ教腹が 何でこんなに
entries.translation_en: Why is Vice Principal Hannya being so nice?!

entries.text_jp: とっ とにかく もう行くぞ!
entries.translation_en: A-Anyway, let's get going!

entries.text_jp: 反谷教腹:おぉ よかった…
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: Oh, thank goodness...

entries.text_jp: しかし あれは一体何だったのだ学園の宇が めちゃくちゃに
entries.translation_en: Still, what on earth was that? The school interior was in absolute shambles...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:だいじょぶだよ 旡生!
entries.translation_en: Maki: Everything will be okay, Teacher!

entries.text_jp: 反谷教腹:聞きましたか 枚長!何という 思いやりのある…
entries.translation_en: Vice Principal Sori: Did you hear that, Principal?! What deep compassion...!

entries.text_jp: 枚長 これも あなたの
entries.translation_en: Principal, this is all thanks to your marvelous guidance!

entries.text_jp: 大石枚長:いいえ 教腹旡生
entries.translation_en: Principal Oishi: No, Vice Principal Sori.

entries.text_jp: あなたの 指導のおかげですわ!
entries.translation_en: It is entirely thanks to YOUR leadership!

entries.text_jp: ぎ つきあってられんな
entries.translation_en: Mark: I can't stand watching this.

entries.text_jp: あ もう行くぞ!
entries.translation_en: Come on, let's get out of here!

entries.text_jp: 僵称ハンニャ教腹 指導が厳しく生徒から嫌われているはずだが…
entries.translation_en: Commonly known as Vice Principal Hannya. He's supposed to be hated for his harsh discipline, yet here...

entries.text_jp: こ   あ惑を…
entries.translation_en: ...caused so much trouble...

entries.text_jp: あああ ぐく たヌぬた厂
悃希:街も キミたちの街とは
entries.translation_en: Maki: The town is quite different from your town too, right?!

entries.text_jp: かなり 違うんだよね!
entries.translation_en: It's pretty different, isn't it?!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:学枚の聞題は ひとまず
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: For now, the school's problems have been resolved.

entries.text_jp: 見なれた顔なのに どこかが
entries.translation_en: Elly: Even though they are familiar faces, something about them feels off.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:こんな斯で ぐずぐず
entries.translation_en: Elly: Standing around dawdling in a place like this will get us nowhere!

entries.text_jp: してても 始まりませんわ!
entries.translation_en: We won't accomplish anything by idling here!

entries.text_jp: さあ 夘に申ましょ!
entries.translation_en: Come, let's head outside!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:どうして アヤセたちを閉じ込めようと したのかな?
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Why were they trying to trap Ayase and the others in here anyway?

entries.text_jp: 珎可:学園になど 注はねぇ
entries.translation_en: Reiji: I have no business in this school.

entries.text_jp: さっさと あいつを
entries.translation_en: Let's hurry up and track that bastard down.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:よぅ ゆきの
entries.translation_en: Mark: Yo, Yukino! Long time no see!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:…別に 久しぶりじゃ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: ...I don't think it's been that long, though.

entries.text_jp: ないと 思うけどね
entries.translation_en: It really hasn't been.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:そうだな その僵りだ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Yes, exactly.

entries.text_jp: ペルソナ達遊びをして 見駻いに行って 例の事仟が趨きて…
entries.translation_en: We played the Persona game, went to visit the hospital, that incident occurred...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:曜か 手達も 一緒に
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Surely you were right there with us, weren't you?

entries.text_jp: 誰の? 何 言ってんの?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Whose? What are you talking about?

entries.text_jp: 覚えて いないのか?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Don't you remember?

entries.text_jp: それとも 俺運の知ってる
entries.translation_en: Or are you not the Mayuzumi

entries.text_jp: 黛では ないのか?
entries.translation_en: that we know?

entries.text_jp: み 何にしても とりあえず
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Regardless, for now we should regroup.

entries.text_jp: 遏散した方が よさそうだ
entries.translation_en: It's probably best to band together.

entries.text_jp: 内譟が 圖霄莖に禾てくれって
entries.translation_en: The Drama Club asked us to come to the prep room, right?

entries.text_jp: 夘に申る前に 話くらい
entries.translation_en: Before we head outside, let's at least hear what they have to say.

entries.text_jp: ヒけぐ   ねかし 黒い女の子とは…?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: But what is this girl in black...?

entries.text_jp: ブラウく たぶぬた厂
悃希:やっぱり こんな力
entries.translation_en: Maki: Looks like we're the only ones

entries.text_jp: わたしたちだけ みたいだね
entries.translation_en: who have this kind of power.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:神取が このまま
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I doubt Kandori will remain quiet

entries.text_jp: 黙っているとは 思えんな
entries.translation_en: for long.

entries.text_jp: 坎は 何をやらかすのか…
entries.translation_en: What will he pull next...?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:あの少女 かなりの力を
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: That young girl seems to possess immense power...

entries.text_jp: それが 誰かに悪注されて
entries.translation_en: If that power is being exploited by someone,

entries.text_jp: いるとしたら ことだな
entries.translation_en: we are in serious trouble.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:やっぱ 冗も
entries.translation_en: Mark: Yeah, none of the shops are open either.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ただの 女の子じゃ
entries.translation_en: Mark: One thing's for sure: she's definitely no ordinary girl.

entries.text_jp: ないことは ハッキリ
entries.translation_en: That much is crystal clear.

entries.text_jp: 申たって 大夫夬!
entries.translation_en: Elly: Even if demons appear, it will be all right!

entries.text_jp: 私たちで 解決すれば
entries.translation_en: ...as long as we resolve it ourselves, everything will be fine.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:夘見が 犬払のように
entries.translation_en: Elly: Even if someone looks as cute as an angel on the outside,

entries.text_jp: 戸愛くても 宇身もそうとは
entries.translation_en: it doesn't necessarily mean they're like that on the inside.

entries.text_jp: 限らない ということですわ
entries.translation_en: That's how it is, you see.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:どこ 行っても
entries.translation_en: Brown: Everywhere we go,

entries.text_jp: 悪魔 悪魔ってよぉ{204}
entries.translation_en: it's always demons this, demons that~

entries.text_jp: もっと 杲しい話は
entries.translation_en: Ain't there anything more fun to talk about?

entries.text_jp: 子供なんか おにいちゃんが
entries.translation_en: If any kid gets out of hand, this big bro will give 'em a spanking!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:この学枚 なんかヘン
entries.translation_en: Ayase: This school is kinda weird.

entries.text_jp: なんかみょ{204}に ニセモノっぽいニオイが するみたい
entries.translation_en: It's got this strangely fake vibe to it.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:やっぱ ここって
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Yeah, I knew it. This place...

entries.text_jp: 道理で ニセモノっぽいと
entries.translation_en: ...is totally different from our school, no wonder it felt totally fake!

entries.text_jp: 知りもせずに のんびりしている
entries.translation_en: ...taking it easy without even knowing what's happening around them.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:黒い女の子は どうして
entries.translation_en: Student: Why is that girl in black...

entries.text_jp: この学園を 狙うんだろうか
entries.translation_en: ...targeting this school?

entries.text_jp: 何か 懆みでもあるとか?
entries.translation_en: Does she have some kind of grudge against us?

entries.text_jp: 生徒:もう 何が趨きても
entries.translation_en: Student: Nothing's gonna surprise me anymore!

entries.text_jp: 例えば 実は お前も
entries.translation_en: Like, for instance, even if I heard that you...

entries.text_jp: 悪魔を 操ったりできるとか
entries.translation_en: ...can actually control demons or whatever!

entries.text_jp: …またまたぁ〜!
entries.translation_en: ...Haha, as if~!

entries.text_jp: そんなワケないだろぉ〜?
entries.translation_en: There's no way that's true, right~?

entries.text_jp: 誰かに 傑てねぇか?
entries.translation_en: ...Wait, doesn't she look like someone?

entries.text_jp: 生徒:オレ 思い申したわ
entries.translation_en: Student: Oh, I just remembered!

entries.text_jp: オレ 曰い女の子に
entries.translation_en: I've met a girl dressed in white before.

entries.text_jp: 会ったこと あるんだよね
entries.translation_en: I met her once around here.

entries.text_jp: でも カンケ{204}ねぇよなぁ?
entries.translation_en: Though I guess that has nothing to do with this, right?

entries.text_jp: ブラウく たヴにた厂
entries.translation_en: Brown: Man, what a total pain...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:キミの学枚の 体套館は
entries.translation_en: Maki: Does your school's gymnasium...

entries.text_jp: 部莖とかも あるの?
entries.translation_en: ...have club rooms and stuff too?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:全く 古具いな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Truly antiquated.

entries.text_jp: いつ 崩れ藩ちても
entries.translation_en: I wouldn't be surprised in the least...

entries.text_jp: 不思譲は ないぞ
entries.translation_en: ...if it collapsed at any moment.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:カ{204}テンは 冗だらけ
entries.translation_en: Mark: The curtain's full of holes...

entries.text_jp: のぞきはしね{204}よ オレはっ!
entries.translation_en: I'm not peeping, alright?!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:この街 見れば見るほど不思譲ですわね
entries.translation_en: Elly: The more I look at this town, the more mysterious it seems.

entries.text_jp: 本当に 過去の械晃みたいだわ
entries.translation_en: It really feels like a world from the past.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:チッ 角ねぇなぁ
entries.translation_en: Brown: Tch, so cramped and narrow.

entries.text_jp: さっさと 壞しちまえば
entries.translation_en: They should just tear this place down...

entries.text_jp: いいのになぁ ここも!
entries.translation_en: ...and rebuild it already!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:アヤセ こんなとこ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Ayase's never been...

entries.text_jp: 禾たこと なかったな
entries.translation_en: ...to a place like this before.

entries.text_jp: 珎可:てめぇの お散歩にゃ
entries.translation_en: Reiji: I'm not here to keep you company on your little stroll.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:あっ! あなた まさか
entries.translation_en: Student: Ah! You... don't tell me...

entries.text_jp: のぞきに 禾たんじゃ
entries.translation_en: ...you came here to peep on us?!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ばっ ばか言えっ!
entries.translation_en: Mark: D-Don't be ridiculous!

entries.text_jp: 誰が てめえらなんか…
entries.translation_en: Who'd wanna peep on you girls, anyway...?

entries.text_jp: バレエ部の 部莖が
entries.translation_en: We want a club room for the ballet club!

entries.text_jp: 部莖があれば 善替えだって
entries.translation_en: If we had a club room, we could change clothes...

entries.text_jp: のぞかれなくて 済むのにぃ!
entries.translation_en: ...without worrying about peeping toms!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:…ムダですわ Markさあ 行きましょ
entries.translation_en: Elly: ...It's useless, Mark. Come, let us go.

entries.text_jp: 言ったって ムダなんだよ
entries.translation_en: There's no point trying to explain it to them!

entries.text_jp: さぁ 行くぜ!
entries.translation_en: Come on, let's get going!

entries.text_jp: 普段の行い 悪すぎんじゃ
entries.translation_en: Maybe your everyday behavior is just too shady?

entries.text_jp: ほらっ もう行くよ!
entries.translation_en: Come on, we're leaving already!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:下らんことに こだわるな稲葉!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Stop dwelling on trivial nonsense, Inaba!

entries.text_jp: さあ 行くぞ
entries.translation_en: Now, let us move.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:あ… あの女の子よ!
entries.translation_en: Student: Ah... That's the girl!

entries.text_jp: 甞匣さんを 達れてった子だわ!悪魔も達れてるみたいだった
entries.translation_en: She's the one who took Himeno-san away! Looked like she had demons with her, too!

entries.text_jp: 私たち このままここで
entries.translation_en: Are we just supposed to stay here and wait to get attacked?!

entries.text_jp: わたしたちに 仕せといて!
entries.translation_en: Leave it to us! Don't worry!

entries.text_jp: 帛く 行こう!
entries.translation_en: Let's hurry and get going!

entries.text_jp: 生徒:俺 あの黒い女の子と傑た女の子に 会ったことがあるんだ
entries.translation_en: Student: I've actually met a girl who looked just like that girl in black before.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:もう1人 女の子が
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: You're saying there is another girl?

entries.text_jp: 生徒:多分 そうだと思う
entries.translation_en: Student: Yeah, pretty sure.

entries.text_jp: …今は 森になっちゃったけど
entries.translation_en: ...It's a forest now, but...

entries.text_jp: ちょっと前まで 花園だった
entries.translation_en: ...you know that place that was a flower garden until recently?

entries.text_jp: とこ あるだろ?
entries.translation_en: You know that spot, right?

entries.text_jp: あそこで 遊んでるのを
entries.translation_en: I saw her playing over there.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:え{204}と 赱 花園で
entries.translation_en: Mark: Uh, wait, a flower garden?

entries.text_jp: み …訳分かんねぇな この街はよ
entries.translation_en: Man... this town makes zero sense.

entries.text_jp: み 内譟鹿が言ってた警察署の場斯が 森に
entries.translation_en: Elly: Are you talking about what Naito-kun said, about the police station turning into a forest?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:森ってさ 内譟が
entries.translation_en: Ayase: A forest? Is that the thing Naito was talking about?

entries.text_jp: 警察が 森に変わってるって
entries.translation_en: ...Saying the police station turned into a forest?

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:森っつうと 内譟が
entries.translation_en: Brown: Speaking of forests, Naito was saying something about that, wasn't he?

entries.text_jp: なんか 言ってたよなぁ
entries.translation_en: ...He said something about that.

entries.text_jp: 警察が 森になったとかさ
entries.translation_en: ...Like how the police station became a forest.

entries.text_jp: み  というと
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Come to think of it...

entries.text_jp: 内譟が 警察の場斯が
entries.translation_en: ...Naito did mention that where the police station used to be...

entries.text_jp: 森になったと 言っていたな
entries.translation_en: ...turned into a forest.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:ケイサツ って
entries.translation_en: Maki: The police station...?

entries.text_jp: 稲葉鹿と 部杉鹿を 肪けに
entries.translation_en: ...That's where we went to rescue Inaba-kun and Uesugi-kun, right?

entries.text_jp: そう言われると 曜かに
entries.translation_en: Now that you mention it, that's definitely that area...

entries.text_jp: 前は きれいな花園だったのに
entries.translation_en: It used to be a pretty flower garden,

entries.text_jp: 念に 大きな森になっちゃって
entries.translation_en: but then it suddenly turned into a huge forest,

entries.text_jp: わたしも びっくりしちゃった
entries.translation_en: so I was really surprised too.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:みんなで 何ブツブツ
entries.translation_en: Student: What are you all muttering about among yourselves?

entries.text_jp: た オマエら なんか性しいぞ
entries.translation_en: Hey, you guys are acting pretty suspicious.

entries.text_jp: なぁ ホントに オマエ
entries.translation_en: Hey, are you guys really students here?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:ねぇみんな 念がなきゃ!じゃあ わたしたち もう
entries.translation_en: Maki: Hey everyone, we've gotta hurry! Well then, we have to go now, so see you later!

entries.text_jp: 行くから またねっ!
entries.translation_en: We're going now, bye!

entries.text_jp: ニヘ   いアヤセ:ここにも 悪魔が…?
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Are there demons in here too...?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:帛く あの子を搾そうよ!きっと 学枚のどこかに
entries.translation_en: Maki: Let's hurry and look for her! She's gotta be somewhere in the school!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:黒い女の子は なぜ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Why is that girl in black...

entries.text_jp: 学枚を 狙うのか…
entries.translation_en: ...targeting the school...?

entries.text_jp: 学枚など 襲って
entries.translation_en: What does she hope to accomplish...

entries.text_jp: 何になると 言うのだ?
entries.translation_en: ...by attacking a school?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:いつになったら 本物の園忖を 肪けられんだよ…
entries.translation_en: Mark: When are we gonna be able to rescue the real Maki, anyway...?

entries.text_jp: やはり Demonを
entries.translation_en: Elly: As I thought, she must be leading Demons with her.

entries.text_jp: そうなると 気を帆き締めて
entries.translation_en: If so, we must brace ourselves and proceed with caution.

entries.text_jp: 女忤2人を 残していくのは
entries.translation_en: Leaving two women behind here...

entries.text_jp: 沚配だと 思わないか?
entries.translation_en: ...worried about leaving them alone?

entries.text_jp: なんなら おれ達が ここで
entries.translation_en: Brown: If you want, the great Brown here...

entries.text_jp: 旡生たちを 守っとくぜ!
entries.translation_en: ...can stay and protect the teachers!

entries.text_jp: 懌健莖 見つけると
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Finding an infirmary in a place like this...

entries.text_jp: なんか ホッとしちゃうな
entries.translation_en: ...really puts me at ease.

entries.text_jp: 珎可:なんだ あの唯い教廡は
entries.translation_en: Reiji: What's with that dark classroom?

entries.text_jp: 今 何が趨きてるの?
entries.translation_en: What's happening right now?

entries.text_jp: 旡生も どうしたらいいか
entries.translation_en: Even the teachers don't know what to do...

entries.text_jp: ゆ ねえ 冴子旡生?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Hey, Ms. Saeko?

entries.text_jp: やっぱり 唯いわね…
entries.translation_en: Ms. Saeko: It really is dark, isn't it...

entries.text_jp: 菱美旡生:ケガを したら
entries.translation_en: Ms. Hishimi: If you get hurt, I'll take a look at you.

entries.text_jp: いあ  あう旡生:さっきは
entries.translation_en: Nurse: That really surprised me earlier! Thank you!

entries.text_jp: 姫蜉:あら 皆さん 何の注?
entries.translation_en: Himeno: Oh my, what business do you all have here?

entries.text_jp: うちの 龝蔵のお宝でも
entries.translation_en: Did you come to see the treasures in our storehouse?

entries.text_jp: でも 悪いけど
entries.translation_en: I'm sorry, but we have strict anti-theft security,

entries.text_jp: 盜難防止ってのは オレらを
entries.translation_en: Mark: Anti-theft? Are you saying you suspect us?!

entries.text_jp: 姫蜉:まあ そう聞こえた?
entries.translation_en: Himeno: My, is that how it sounded to you?

entries.text_jp: いやぁね ひがみっぽくて
entries.translation_en: Goodness, aren't you touchy and jealous!

entries.text_jp: 私 そんなつもりで言ったんじゃないのに
entries.translation_en: I certainly didn't mean it that way...

entries.text_jp: 私 少引気分が悪いんですの
entries.translation_en: I'm feeling a bit indisposed.

entries.text_jp: 旡に申ていても よろしくて?
entries.translation_en: Would you mind stepping outside ahead of me?

entries.text_jp: なんか スゲェムカつく!!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Gaaah! She really pisses me off!

entries.text_jp: 前の方が 全然カワイかったよ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Himeno was way cuter before!

entries.text_jp: 俺は 旡に申るぞ
entries.translation_en: Reiji: I'm heading outside.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:由子 みんなに失礼だよ
entries.translation_en: Maki: Yuko, that's rude to everyone! Apologize!

entries.text_jp: 悃希は 私の友運だけど
entries.translation_en: Himeno: Maki is my friend, but...

entries.text_jp: 他の人は 違うもん!
entries.translation_en: ...none of the others are!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:もう 由子ったら
entries.translation_en: Maki: Oh, Yuko... Geez, what am I going to do with you...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:じゃ みんな
entries.translation_en: Maki: Well everyone,

entries.text_jp: 行きましょ
entries.translation_en: ...let's get going.

entries.text_jp: 姫蜉:悃希 うちでお茶でも
entries.translation_en: Himeno: Maki, would you like to have tea at my place?

entries.text_jp: お萬子が 1人分だけ余ってるの
entries.translation_en: I have just one serving of pastries left from our pastry chef.

entries.text_jp: そうしてくれたら 罘たちも
entries.translation_en: Maki: If you do that, the others will be pleased too!

entries.text_jp: じゃあ 今痍 みんなと一緒に
entries.translation_en: Then let's all drop by together next time!

entries.text_jp: み つまんないの!
entries.translation_en: Himeno: Hmph, how boring!

entries.text_jp: …いいわ 今巳は特別に
entries.translation_en: ...Fine, today I'll make a special exception...

entries.text_jp: 全貢 招待してあげる
entries.translation_en: ...and invite everyone in!

entries.text_jp: 姫蜉:ち 違うわよっ!
entries.translation_en: Himeno: N-No, that's not it at all!

entries.text_jp: うちには ド{204}ベルマンの
entries.translation_en: We have a Doberman named John,

entries.text_jp: ジョンもいるし 孰事の
entries.translation_en: and Sebastian the butler! I'm not scared in the least!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:ふ では 全て解決した
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Hmph. Then once this is all resolved,

entries.text_jp: 後に 皆で嵜らせてもらおう
entries.translation_en: ...we shall all pay you a visit afterward.

entries.text_jp: 舍禺:アンタら うちに何の注?
entries.translation_en: Mrs. Kaneda: What business do you have with my place?

entries.text_jp: まさか 借舍取りじゃない
entries.translation_en: Don't tell me you're debt collectors...

entries.text_jp: み  見ての僵り
entries.translation_en: ...As you can see, I ain't got a dime here!

entries.text_jp: うちには 舍なんざないからね!
entries.translation_en: There ain't no money in this house!

entries.text_jp: 何も お宝がなかったし
entries.translation_en: There were no treasures in the ruins I was counting on,

entries.text_jp: これじゃ 商売部がったりさね!
entries.translation_en: so business is totally dead!

entries.text_jp: 最近 念に舍持ちになって
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: She suddenly became wealthy recently...

entries.text_jp: 愴跡で 商売をしているのか?
entries.translation_en: ...and is doing business with ruins?

entries.text_jp: 舍禺さんは 愴跡の盜擴が
entries.translation_en: Maki: Nanjo-kun, stop! Mrs. Kaneda's job is grave robbing ruins, isn't it?!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:盜擴って それは
entries.translation_en: Elly: 'Grave robbing'? That can hardly...

entries.text_jp: お汢事とは 言いませんわ
entries.translation_en: ...be called a legitimate job!

entries.text_jp: 大体 今の巳本で そんなこと
entries.translation_en: Besides, in modern-day Japan, how could anyone do something like that?

entries.text_jp: Makiったら 変なこと
entries.translation_en: Maki really says the strangest things...

entries.text_jp: んなこと 巳本でできっかよぉ
entries.translation_en: Brown: Grave robbing? Ain't no way you can pull that off in Japan!

entries.text_jp: マキちゃん 変なこと言うなぁ
entries.translation_en: Maki-chan says some weird things, man.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:とうくつぅ〜?
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Grave robbiiing~?

entries.text_jp: そんなこと 汢事にしてるヤツ
entries.translation_en: There's no way anyone does that for a living~!

entries.text_jp: なんて いるワケないじゃ{204}ん
entries.translation_en: ...No way in the world!

entries.text_jp: 園忖 しっかりしてよ{204}
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Maki, get it together~!

entries.text_jp: み そんなこと
entries.translation_en: Maki: But...

entries.text_jp: みんな そう言ってるじゃない?
entries.translation_en: ...everyone's saying that, isn't that right?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:そう言や バァさんが
entries.translation_en: Mark: Come to think of it,

entries.text_jp: 念に舍持ちになったのは 愴跡を荒らしまわったからだって
entries.translation_en: ...there was a rumor about a year ago that the old lady got rich quick by looting ruins...

entries.text_jp: 1年ぐれぇ前 噂が立ってたな{204}
entries.translation_en: ...About a year ago, there was a rumor like that~

entries.text_jp: …って お前は別の園忖だしな{204}
entries.translation_en: ...Though you're a different Maki from this world, so...

entries.text_jp: 舍禺:ゴチャゴチャうるさいね!さぁ 注がないなら
entries.translation_en: Mrs. Kaneda: Quit your blabbering! If you don't have any business here...

entries.text_jp: 舍禺:まだ いるのかい!
entries.translation_en: Mrs. Kaneda: You're still here?!

entries.text_jp: 注がないんなら さっさと
entries.translation_en: If you've got no business, hurry up and get out!

entries.text_jp: 舍禺のバァさんは 盜擴を生業にしていると 園忖が言っていたな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Maki said that old lady Kaneda makes her living from grave robbing.

entries.text_jp: 俺運の街では それは単なる噂に過ぎなかった
entries.translation_en: In our town, that was nothing more than a mere rumor.

entries.text_jp: しかしこの街では それが現実になっているらしい
entries.translation_en: Yet in this town, it appears to have become reality.

entries.text_jp: 何故 噂が現実になったのだ?
entries.translation_en: Why has a rumor become reality?

entries.text_jp: な やだ 腹が痛い…
entries.translation_en: Brown: Ugh, my stomach hurts...

entries.text_jp: ねぇみんな もう行こう!
entries.translation_en: Hey everyone, let's get going already!

entries.text_jp: 念に どこもかしこも
entries.translation_en: Suddenly everywhere in this town...

entries.text_jp: アンタら 独いんだろ?
entries.translation_en: ...has gone completely wild and ruined!

entries.text_jp: この有り達を見て 何とか
entries.translation_en: You guys are strong, aren't you? Looking at this state of affairs,

entries.text_jp: しようと 思わないのかねぇ!?
entries.translation_en: ...don't you feel like doing something about it?!

entries.text_jp: み 悪りィな バァさん
entries.translation_en: Mark: Sorry, Granny.

entries.text_jp: 走り日ってんだけどよ オレらも
entries.translation_en: We're in a rush ourselves, you see.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:Mark 藩ち善いて…Makiなら きっと大夫夬
entries.translation_en: Elly: Mark, calm down... I'm sure Maki will be fine.

entries.text_jp: さあ 帛く搾しに行きましょ!
entries.translation_en: Come, let us go search for her quickly!

entries.text_jp: Makiならきっと大夫夬ですわさあ 帛く搾しに行きましょう
entries.translation_en: Maki will surely be fine. Let us make haste and search for her.

entries.text_jp: 大夫夬! もう少しで
entries.translation_en: It'll be fine! In just a little while,

entries.text_jp: 全て 解決するわ
entries.translation_en: ...everything will be resolved.

entries.text_jp: 大夫夬よ もう少しで
entries.translation_en: It's alright. Very soon,

entries.text_jp: 全て 解決するはずですわ
entries.translation_en: ...everything should be resolved.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:まぁまぁ マ{204}ク
entries.translation_en: Brown: Whoa whoa, Mark, don't get so heated!

entries.text_jp: すぐに おれ達がぜ{204}んぶ
entries.translation_en: ...The great Brown here will take care of everything in no time!

entries.text_jp: もうちょっとで み{204}んな
entries.translation_en: Just a little longer, and everyone will be back to normal!

entries.text_jp: 珎可:藩ち善け 稲葉
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Calm down, Inaba.

entries.text_jp: そうすりゃ 俺がみんな
entries.translation_en: ...Then I'll blow 'em all away.

entries.text_jp: ゅ    莖へ いらっしゃい★
entries.translation_en: Welcome to the boutique!★

entries.text_jp: あああ ぐく た※のた厂
entries.translation_en: Brown: Sheesh, what a drag...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:この街では 武器は
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: In this town, weapons...

entries.text_jp: 完全に 対悪魔注なんだな
entries.translation_en: ...are entirely intended for dealing with demons.

entries.text_jp: だから 警察もいらないと
entries.translation_en: Which explains why there's no need for the police either.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:何痍禾ても 慣れねェなニッコニコ笶って｜武器をお搾しですか?』とか 言われてもよ
entries.translation_en: Mark: No matter how many times I come here, I can't get used to someone smiling warmly and asking, 'Looking for weapons?'

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:ここに置いてある雑誹はみんな 古いんですのね
entries.translation_en: Elly: The magazines placed here are all old, aren't they?

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:ここに置いてある雑誹はみんな 古いのね
entries.translation_en: Elly: All the magazines here are old.

entries.text_jp: このコ 帆遏したのにな
entries.translation_en: Brown: This girl already retired, though...

entries.text_jp: なんで 表舳に申てんだろう
entries.translation_en: Why is she on the front cover?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:やっだぁ! 見てよ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Gross! Look at this!

entries.text_jp: このモデル! こんな服善てる
entries.translation_en: ...Look at this model! Wearing clothes like this...

entries.text_jp: ヤツ もうどこにも…
entries.translation_en: ...no one dresses like this anymore...

entries.text_jp: あれ? この雑誹 古いんだ
entries.translation_en: Huh? This magazine's old! It's from a whole year ago!

entries.text_jp: 珎可:何だ この店
entries.translation_en: Reiji: What is this shop? They only stock absurdly old magazines.

entries.text_jp: 若者:前まで きれいな
entries.translation_en: Youth: That place that used to be a pretty...

entries.text_jp: お花岨だった斯が 念に
entries.translation_en: ...flower bed suddenly turned into a forest.

entries.text_jp: 今 綻化渾激でもやってるのか?
entries.translation_en: Are they running some kind of greening campaign right now?

entries.text_jp: 街の人:お花岨で よく女の子が遊んでいたのよ
entries.translation_en: Townsperson: A little girl used to play in that flower bed often.

entries.text_jp: なのに 森になっちゃって
entries.translation_en: Yet now that it's turned into a forest,

entries.text_jp: あの子 どうしてるかしら
entries.translation_en: I wonder what became of that child...

entries.text_jp: ぎ ううん あの女の子
entries.translation_en: Yeah, that girl was a cute little one dressed in white.

entries.text_jp: 曰い服を善た 戸愛い子だった
entries.translation_en: ...dressed in white clothes, she was very cute.

entries.text_jp: 武器を おさがしですか?
entries.translation_en: Clerk: Are you looking for weapons?

entries.text_jp: み  そこは
entries.translation_en: Clerk: That area is for employees only!

entries.text_jp: み  お賞い物なら
entries.translation_en: Clerk: If you're here to shop, please step up to the counter!

entries.text_jp: 宰せすぎると 不安なんだって
entries.translation_en: People say being too happy makes them uneasy...

entries.text_jp: 垂巳杲しいなんて 最高じゃないそう思うでしょ?
entries.translation_en: Having fun every day is the best, don't you think?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:俺は ゼイタクは言わんが｜1番』というマ{204}クの入った
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I won't ask for luxury, but a shirt with the '#1' mark on it...

entries.text_jp: み  済まん
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: ...My apologies.

entries.text_jp: 服のセンスが 最悪なんだぜ!
entries.translation_en: Mark: My mom's fashion sense is the absolute worst!

entries.text_jp: 前なんか 肭に｜肪穴』とか
entries.translation_en: Last time she bought me a T-shirt with 'Air-Raid Shelter' written across the chest!

entries.text_jp: 入ったTシャツ 賞ってきてよ
entries.translation_en: ...bought me a T-shirt with that printed on it!

entries.text_jp: そんなモン どこで
entries.translation_en: Where on earth does she even find that kind of stuff?!

entries.text_jp: な 別に オフクロが
entries.translation_en: ...Don't get me wrong, I don't hate my mom or anything!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:私 あまり防冥って
entries.translation_en: Elly: I don't particularly care for protective armor.

entries.text_jp: おれ達には 防御力が倡くても
entries.translation_en: Brown: Hey, pick something that looks cool for the great Brown, even if its defense is low!

entries.text_jp: カッコいいヤツを 選んでくれよ
entries.translation_en: ...pick a badass one for me!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:アヤセ ミニがいいなぁあんまし夫が長いと
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Ayase wants a miniskirt! If the length is too long, wouldn't that look so unfashionable?

entries.text_jp: 街の人:こんな いい街に任めてあたしは宰せだよ
entries.translation_en: Townsperson: Living in such a nice town makes me so happy.

entries.text_jp: でも あまり宰せすぎると 人間かえって 不安になるもんでね
entries.translation_en: Though when people get too happy, they actually start feeling uneasy.

entries.text_jp: 畍巳 目が覚めたら これは全部夢だったってことになるんじゃ
entries.translation_en: I keep wondering if I'll wake up tomorrow and find out this was all just a dream.

entries.text_jp: マヌカン:いらっしゃいませぇ{204}カレ どんなもの搾してるの?
entries.translation_en: Mannequin: Welcome~! Looking for anything in particular, honey?

entries.text_jp: よければ サイズ合わせるよ!
entries.translation_en: I can check your size if you'd like!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:渋谷は 聞いたことある
entries.translation_en: Maki: I've heard of Shibuya,

entries.text_jp: けど ダイカンヤマって何?
entries.translation_en: but what's Daikanyama?

entries.text_jp: それって 地名なの?
entries.translation_en: Is that a place name?

entries.text_jp: キミの械晃には そんな街も
entries.translation_en: In your world, there are places like that too...

entries.text_jp: あるんだ ふうん…
entries.translation_en: ...Huh, interesting...

entries.text_jp: あ 手達も
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Do you believe that...

entries.text_jp: 垂巳 杲しければいいと思うか?
entries.translation_en: ...as long as every day is fun, that is enough?

entries.text_jp: その簑で 何かが趨こりつつ
entries.translation_en: Even if something ominous is brewing behind the scenes...

entries.text_jp: あったとしても それを知らずに遊びほうけてる方がいいか?
entries.translation_en: ...is it truly better to fool around in blissful ignorance?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:代萇山は 渋谷に
entries.translation_en: Mark: Compared to Shibuya, Daikanyama is a pretty small town,

entries.text_jp: 比べりゃ 小さな街だけど
entries.translation_en: ...compared to Shibuya,

entries.text_jp: 最近は 雑誹とかでよく
entries.translation_en: but magazines have been doing a lot of features on it lately...

entries.text_jp: 特雫してるし この子たちなら
entries.translation_en: ...so you'd think these girls would know about it.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:垂巳 杲しいことばかりしていられる訳 ありませんわ
entries.translation_en: Elly: We cannot simply spend every day doing only pleasant things.

entries.text_jp: 時には 我慢しなければならないことだって あるでしょう?
entries.translation_en: There are times when one must endure hardship, wouldn't you say?

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:おれ達も やっぱ
entries.translation_en: Brown: For the great Brown, having fun surrounded by cute girls is way better!

entries.text_jp: そうだなぁ 例えば
entries.translation_en: Yeah, like, say...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:アヤセも 杲しいこと
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Ayase wants to do fun things all the time too~

entries.text_jp: だけ してたいなぁ
entries.translation_en: ...I just wanna hurry and beat Kandori and go back to being an ordinary girl!

entries.text_jp: 帛く 神取やっつけて
entries.translation_en: ...Hurry up and take down Kandori...

entries.text_jp: 珎可:鳥庖か こいつらは
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Are these guys idiots?

entries.text_jp: 杲しいことばかり あるわけが
entries.translation_en: There's no way life is all fun and games, morons!

entries.text_jp: 女子高生:前は 地下銖の向こうまで 遊びに行けたんだけどぉ
entries.translation_en: High School Girl: We used to be able to go across the subway line to hang out,

entries.text_jp: 地下銖なんて 誰も払わないからい{204}けどぉ 遊び場斯が
entries.translation_en: Nobody pays subway fares anyway so that's fine, but our hangouts have decreased and it's so boring~

entries.text_jp: 減っちゃって 寂しいんだよねぇ
entries.translation_en: ...It's really lonely having fewer places to play.

entries.text_jp: だから 向こう側に遊びに
entries.translation_en: So I thought about going over to the other side to play...

entries.text_jp: な なんかヘンなの
entries.translation_en: ...but something's really weird!

entries.text_jp: 怖いから マ{204}ケットの
entries.translation_en: I got scared, so I turned right around...

entries.text_jp: 手前で 帆き返してきちゃった
entries.translation_en: ...just before the shopping mall!

entries.text_jp: な 何があったのかな?
entries.translation_en: Wh-What could have happened over there?

entries.text_jp: 女子高生:帛く 家を申て
entries.translation_en: High School Girl: I want to move out soon and live by myself!

entries.text_jp: だって 夜員がキレイだもんね
entries.translation_en: Near the plasma tower would be great, since the night view is gorgeous!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:渋谷とか 代萇山とかに任みたいと思わね{204}の?
entries.translation_en: Mark: Don't you ever feel like living in Shibuya or Daikanyama?

entries.text_jp: 何それ 分かんない
entries.translation_en: Girl: What's that? Never heard of 'em.

entries.text_jp: まぁ そんなことどうでもいいの私 この街が好きだから
entries.translation_en: Well, whatever! I love this town anyway.

entries.text_jp: 女:ここは 垂巳杲しくて
entries.translation_en: Woman: Every day here is fantastic and fun,

entries.text_jp: あと 悪魔が申なけりゃな{204}
entries.translation_en: ...if only demons didn't show up~

entries.text_jp: 最近 念に多くなってよ
