entries.translation_en: There's been a sudden surge of them lately.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:街の悪魔が 念に塘えたのつい最近のことだよ
entries.translation_en: Maki: The demons in town only suddenly increased very recently.

entries.text_jp: でも 塘えはしたけど 人が
entries.translation_en: Even though they increased, I haven't heard much...

entries.text_jp: 襲われたって話は あんまり
entries.translation_en: ...about people actually getting attacked.

entries.text_jp: しかし 俺運は 現に
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: However, we have in fact...

entries.text_jp: 悪魔が 人を選んでいると
entries.translation_en: ...seen demons attacking people. Could it be that demons are selectively choosing their victims?

entries.text_jp: み まさかな…
entries.translation_en: ...No, that can't be...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:お前も 難しい顔ばっかしてね{204}で 畍るく行こうぜ!
entries.translation_en: Mark: Stop making such gloomy faces all the time, let's keep things cheerful!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:最近 お眦が荒れ気味
entries.translation_en: Elly: My skin has been breaking out lately... Battles have been quite harsh, after all.

entries.text_jp: 黠楫 Hardなんですもの
entries.translation_en: ...Battles have been quite Hard, after all.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:最近 疸れがなかなか取れなくてさぁ
entries.translation_en: Brown: Man, I can't shake off my fatigue lately... Guess none of us can beat father time!

entries.text_jp: おれ達も トシには勝てないのね
entries.translation_en: ...Guess even we can't beat our age, huh?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:う うっそぉ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: N-No way!

entries.text_jp: ガラガラドリンクって マムシ
entries.translation_en: ...Rattle Drink is made from viper snake?!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ 飲んじゃったよぉ{204}!
entries.translation_en: Ayase drank that stuff~?!

entries.text_jp: 珎可:いや 別に疸れている
entries.translation_en: Reiji: No, I'm not particularly tired.

entries.text_jp: 街の人:この前までは 黒い服の女の子が申た時だけ 悪魔に
entries.translation_en: Townsperson: Until recently, demons only attacked when that girl in black showed up...

entries.text_jp: でも 女の子もいないのに
entries.translation_en: ...but now they show up even when she isn't around,

entries.text_jp: なっちゃって 不安だよ
entries.translation_en: ...so I'm really worried.

entries.text_jp: 街の人:みんなは 悪魔を
entries.translation_en: Townsperson: Everyone is terrified of the demons,

entries.text_jp: 恐れてるけど 沚配する必要
entries.translation_en: ...but there's no need to worry.

entries.text_jp: きっと 私たちは襲われないわ
entries.translation_en: I'm sure we won't be attacked.

entries.text_jp: 店工:鹿たち うちのバカ基子
entries.translation_en: Shopkeeper: You guys know my idiot son?

entries.text_jp: 同じクラスに 戸愛い女の子が
entries.translation_en: Ever since a cute girl transferred into his class,

entries.text_jp: 梠忤が悪くて 日もきこうと
entries.translation_en: ...he's been in a foul mood and won't say a word to me!

entries.text_jp: あ 檠ね はいはい
entries.translation_en: Shopkeeper: Oh, a lie? Sure, sure.

entries.text_jp: 店工:おっと そこ闢けると
entries.translation_en: Shopkeeper: Whoops! If you open that door, a demon will jump out at you!

entries.text_jp: や〜い だまされた!
entries.translation_en: Ha-ha! You fell for it!

entries.text_jp: ういだなんて 誰も払わないからい{204}けどぉ 遊び場斯が
entries.translation_en: ...Nobody pays fare anyway so that's fine, but our hangouts are gone!

entries.text_jp: 鍵って 一体何なんだろうね?
entries.translation_en: Maki: We're going to the forest, right? I wonder what that key could possibly be?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:帛く あのお埴に
entries.translation_en: Maki: Let's hurry back to that castle!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:あせっても 汢方がない
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Rushing will not help us.

entries.text_jp: 1つ1つ 曜実に進めていくのが黠局は 一番帛い道だ
entries.translation_en: Taking things one step at a time with certainty is ultimately the fastest path.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:｜破魔の鍖』も 手に
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Now that we have the Devil-banishing Mirror in hand,

entries.text_jp: 入れたことだし 気は進まんが
entries.translation_en: ...reluctant though I am, shall we head to the subway?
Mark: No burgers, no fries, no chicken, no shakes... What a rip-off!

entries.text_jp: チキンも シェイクもね{204}のかよつまんね{204}よ!
entries.translation_en: ...No chicken, no shakes either? This sucks!

entries.text_jp: 何も 売るモンがないくせに
entries.translation_en: You've got nothing to sell, yet the clerk's acting all high and mighty!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:あの うさんくせ{204}
entries.translation_en: Mark: Can't really trust that shady old guy,

entries.text_jp: オヤジ 信注はできね{204}けど
entries.translation_en: ...can't really trust him, but...

entries.text_jp: 一応 搾してみっか?
entries.translation_en: ...wanna look around for that 'Devil-banishing Mirror' just in case?

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:以前は 嵜り道なんて
entries.translation_en: Elly: I never used to take detours before,

entries.text_jp: あまり したことが
entries.translation_en: ...I never really used to,

entries.text_jp: わりと 杲しいんですのね
entries.translation_en: ...but doing this is surprisingly fun!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:神扎に 行きましょうよどんな人が待っているのか
entries.translation_en: Elly: Let us head to the shrine! I am very curious to see who awaits us there!

entries.text_jp: 私 とても興味がありますの!
entries.translation_en: I am very curious indeed!

entries.text_jp: 食い物がないとは これいかに?なははは!
entries.translation_en: Brown: A diner with no food? How does that even work?! Wahaha!

entries.text_jp: ちくしょ{204} ハラ減ったよぉ{204}
entries.translation_en: Damn it, I'm so starved~!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:そろそろ 神扎に
entries.translation_en: Brown: Guess it's about time we head over to the shrine!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:神扎 行こうよぉ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Let's go to the shrine~

entries.text_jp: み …アヤセ リンゴアメ食べたいな
entries.translation_en: ...Ayase wants some candy apples~

entries.text_jp: ここにいると 身体があちこち
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Staying in this place makes my whole body start itching.

entries.text_jp: 珎可:神扎 行かねぇのか?
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Aren't we going to the shrine?

entries.text_jp: あの黒瓜って奴 嘘は
entries.translation_en: ...That guy didn't seem to be lying.

entries.text_jp: 店貢:食い物なら ない!
entries.translation_en: Clerk: We ain't got food!

entries.text_jp: だが ここで一休みすれば
entries.translation_en: But if you take a breather here,

entries.text_jp: 鹿の友人も 腹が冴えて
entries.translation_en: ...your friend's mind'll clear right up,

entries.text_jp: 坎の目吋を 思い申すこと
entries.translation_en: ...and they're guaranteed to recall their next objective!

entries.text_jp: 街の人:柞巳 悪魔とバッタリ
entries.translation_en: Townsperson: Yesterday I ran right into a demon,

entries.text_jp: こっちの顔 じ{204}っと
entries.translation_en: ...it stared intently right into my face,

entries.text_jp: 街の人:鹿たちって 何か
entries.translation_en: Townsperson: You guys seem somewhat...

entries.text_jp: 私たちとは 違うみたい
entries.translation_en: ...different from the rest of us. Can't put my finger on it, though...

entries.text_jp: 街の人:鹿 すごくいい人だね
entries.translation_en: Townsperson: You're a really good person. I can tell.

entries.text_jp: きっと お友運もそう思ってる
entries.translation_en: I'm sure your friends think so too.

entries.text_jp: 街の人:鹿って 陰では 黠楫
entries.translation_en: Townsperson: You're actually doing bad things behind everyone's back, aren't you?

entries.text_jp: そのせいで 搗ついてる人も
entries.translation_en: Don't forget that people are getting hurt because of that!

entries.text_jp: いるってこと 忘れないで!
entries.translation_en: ...Don't you ever forget that!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:あのお面 戸愛い!
entries.translation_en: Maki: That mask is so cute!

entries.text_jp: 部厘に かざりたいな
entries.translation_en: I want to decorate my room with it.

entries.text_jp: だまされて 性しげなものを
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Don't get tricked into buying suspicious junk!

entries.text_jp: 気になる 今巳このごろ…
entries.translation_en: Mark: The relationship between those two really makes me wonder these days...

entries.text_jp: これは 巳本の 宰渾を唾ぶ
entries.translation_en: Elly: This is a figurine said to bring good fortune in Japan, right?

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:これって 尤?
entries.translation_en: Brown: Is this a fox? A beckoning fox?

entries.text_jp: なんか 違うよ{204}な…
entries.translation_en: ...Feels like something's off~

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:アヤセ これ歓しい!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Ayase wants this!

entries.text_jp: ね{204} 賞ってよ!
entries.translation_en: Hey~, buy it for me!

entries.text_jp: 置物まで 性しいな
entries.translation_en: Reiji: If the clerk is suspicious, even the ornaments look suspicious.

entries.text_jp: 街の人:最近 悪魔が塘えたよねでも 前に黒い女の子が達れてた悪魔とは 感じが違うんだ
entries.translation_en: Townsperson: Demons have increased lately. But they feel different from the demons that girl in black was leading around before.

entries.text_jp: チ  えうてきやがる
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Tch, trying to be funny, huh...

entries.text_jp: あああ ちく たぉねた厂
entries.translation_en: Brown: Man, what a total drag...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:俺運の街でも コンビニで武器を売るようになる巳が
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Will the day ever come when convenience stores sell weapons in our town as well?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:チッ 武器ばっかかよ
entries.translation_en: Mark: Tch, nothing but weapons?

entries.text_jp: なんか 寂しいぜ
entries.translation_en: Without a book corner, it feels kind of lonely.

entries.text_jp: 何が あったのかしらね?
entries.translation_en: Elly: I wonder what could have happened?

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:見ろよ この槙
entries.translation_en: Brown: Check out this picture!

entries.text_jp: …えっ マジモンなの?
entries.translation_en: ...Wait, is this the real deal?!

entries.text_jp: 珎可:ナスカの 地部槙に
entries.translation_en: Reiji: It looks remarkably like the Nazca geoglyphs.

entries.text_jp: よく 傑ているな
entries.translation_en: ...It looks remarkably similar.

entries.text_jp: 店貢:は{204}い みんな 赱気{204}?Yin＆Yanへ ようこそ!
entries.translation_en: Shopkeeper: Hii~, is everyone doing greaaat? Welcome to Yin & Yan!

entries.text_jp: さあ 何を賞ってくれるのかナ?
entries.translation_en: Now, what are you gonna buy from me today?

entries.text_jp: 店貢:やっだ{204} キミってば
entries.translation_en: Shopkeeper: Oh stooop~, you're not...

entries.text_jp: もしかして 独盜なのかナ?
entries.translation_en: ...a robber by any chance, are you?

entries.text_jp: ボク そういう悪いコは
entries.translation_en: I really hate bad kids like that!★

entries.text_jp: もう 会ったかい?
entries.translation_en: Customer: Have you met Lady Harem Queen yet?

entries.text_jp: クイ{204}ン達はな すっごく
entries.translation_en: Lady Queen is a very delicate person!

entries.text_jp: いいか 間違ってもクイ{204}ン達を搗つけないように するんだぞ!
entries.translation_en: Listen, don't you dare hurt Lady Queen's feelings under any circumstances!

entries.text_jp: 茖:クイ{204}ンは いなく
entries.translation_en: Customer: The Queen is gone, they say!

entries.text_jp: やっと のびのびできるぜ!
entries.translation_en: We can finally relax freely now!

entries.text_jp: ゆた  いいゃ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: No...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:千串の槙も 悪くないと
entries.translation_en: Maki: I think Chisato's art isn't bad at all...

entries.text_jp: とっても お傑合いだったなぁ
entries.translation_en: ...It suited her very well.

entries.text_jp: そう言えば あきが
entries.translation_en: Come to think of it, Maki was saying something about a 'cute girl'...

entries.text_jp: まあ らしいと言えばらしいが
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Well, it does sound like her, but to think Chisato is the 'Harem Queen'...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:これで やっと神取の
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: With this, we have finally grasped Kandori's whereabouts.

entries.text_jp: しかし｜埴』とは 何とも…
entries.translation_en: Still, a 'castle'... How absurd...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:まさか この年になって
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: To think that at my age, I would be setting off to explore a 'haunted mansion'...

entries.text_jp: ことになるとは 思わなかったぞ
entries.translation_en: ...I never would have imagined.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:防冥厘まで この街に
entries.translation_en: Mark: Even the air-raid shelters match this town's vibe perfectly.

entries.text_jp: 園忖のこと 気ィ払ってやれよ
entries.translation_en: Make sure you pay attention to Maki.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:なんかよ オレら
entries.translation_en: Mark: Feels like maybe we ended up doing something unnecessary...

entries.text_jp: 私も アフロにしてみようかしら
entries.translation_en: Elly: I wonder if I should try getting an afro too?

entries.text_jp: もう おれ達に仕してくれよ!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Just leave it to the great Brown already!

entries.text_jp: 女の子なら きっとおれ達の
entries.translation_en: If it's a girl, she'll definitely fall for the great Brown!

entries.text_jp: ガキが お埴に任んでるだぁ?
entries.translation_en: Brown: Some cheeky brat is living in a castle?! You gotta be kidding me!

entries.text_jp: お埴ってのは おれ達みたいな
entries.translation_en: A castle is only fitting for sophisticated people like the great Brown here!

entries.text_jp: 人間にこそ 傑合うものなのよ!
entries.translation_en: ...fitting for someone like me!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:甞匣ってば 本物の
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Chisato's prettier than the real thing...

entries.text_jp: 甞匣って 何が不梼なの?
entries.translation_en: She's so gorgeous, what could she possibly be dissatisfied with?

entries.text_jp: アヤセは 今のままでいいもん
entries.translation_en: Ayase is happy just the way she is!

entries.text_jp: そばかすだってカワイイし
entries.translation_en: Freckles are cute too, after all!

entries.text_jp: 珎可:とにかく ここから
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Anyway, let's get out of here.

entries.text_jp: 珎可:全く てめぇも園忖も
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Good grief, both you and Sonomura are too soft for your own good.

entries.text_jp: 珎可:こういう時は 周りが
entries.translation_en: Reiji: At times like this, no matter what anyone around you says, it doesn't matter...

entries.text_jp: 何を言ったって しょうがねぇ…自分で何とかするしかねぇんだ
entries.translation_en: Nothing anyone says matters... You just have to deal with it on your own.

entries.text_jp: 店貢:あなたも 当店の防冥で
entries.translation_en: Clerk: Equip yourself with our shop's protective gear to survive this world!

entries.text_jp: 防冥のことなら 当店にお仕せを
entries.translation_en: When it comes to armor, leave it to our shop!

entries.text_jp: 茖:どぉせ このマ{204}ケットに
entries.translation_en: Customer: We're trapped in this shopping mall anyway, so we might as well live happily under Lady Queen!

entries.text_jp: せいぜい クイ{204}ンの
entries.translation_en: ...under the Queen's rule...

entries.text_jp: 茖:もう クイ{204}ンのご機嫌
entries.translation_en: Customer: We don't have to butter up the Queen anymore, right? But somehow it feels a little lonely!

entries.text_jp: 取ったりしなくて い{204}のよね?でも 何だかちょっと寂しいナ!
entries.translation_en: ...We don't need to flatter her anymore, right? But it feels kinda lonely!

entries.text_jp: …ううん 何でもない
entries.translation_en: ...No, never mind.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:こっちでも 医者は
entries.translation_en: Mark: Glad the doctor over here is just the same as back home.

entries.text_jp: 同じで 肪かったな
entries.translation_en: ...Glad he's a decent guy.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:医者は 普僵なんだ…
entries.translation_en: Brown: The doctor's normal... What a relief!

entries.text_jp: 奴とかだったら どうしようかとヒヤヒヤしちゃったぜ!
entries.translation_en: ...I was trembling thinking he might be some bald guy covered in bandages!

entries.text_jp: み 住射は
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Injections hurt so much!

entries.text_jp: 肴護嫦:こんなに私が宰せなのもみんな ハ{204}レム'クイ{204}ン達のおかげなんです
entries.translation_en: Nurse: That I am so blissful is entirely thanks to Lady Harem Queen!

entries.text_jp: あなたも一緒に クイ{204}ン達に
entries.translation_en: Let us thank Lady Queen together!

entries.text_jp: お礼を 言いましょうよ
entries.translation_en: Let us express our gratitude!

entries.text_jp: クイ{204}ン達 どうもありがとう!
entries.translation_en: Thank you so very much, Lady Queen!

entries.text_jp: 肴護嫦:私が 宰せなのは
entries.translation_en: Nurse: My happiness wasn't thanks to Lady Queen after all!

entries.text_jp: じゃあ 私 何のおかげで
entries.translation_en: Then what on earth has made me happy all this time?

entries.text_jp: 医廡:なんだ 鳳邪か?
entries.translation_en: Doctor: What, a cold?

entries.text_jp: 鳳邪なら 寝りゃ冶る!
entries.translation_en: If it's a cold, just sleep it off and you'll heal! What'll it be?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:ここの 千年万年棠って
entries.translation_en: Maki: Is the Sennen-Mannen-Do here really that bizarre?

entries.text_jp: まともな店は ないようだな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: It appears there isn't a single normal shop around here.

entries.text_jp: 千年万年棠の お萬子は
entries.translation_en: Mark: Can't we eat sweets from Sennen-Mannen-Do in this town?

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:How exotic!素敵なお店ですわ!
entries.translation_en: Elly: How exotic! What a wonderful shop!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:このツボ いいなぁ
entries.translation_en: Brown: I like this vase...

entries.text_jp: あさぁ コレ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Ugh, look at this...

entries.text_jp: すっごい ヘンな化粧{204}!
entries.translation_en: ...What totally bizarre makeup~!

entries.text_jp: 珎可:…ここは お化け厘敷か?
entries.translation_en: Reiji: ...Is this a haunted house?

entries.text_jp: 呵にぬれた 小尤みたいな
entries.translation_en: Customer: If I were a handsome boy like a little fox drenched in the rain...

entries.text_jp: 美少年だったら クイ{204}ン達に
entries.translation_en: ...I'm sure Lady Queen would have taken a liking to me!

entries.text_jp: そしたら こんな角いとこじゃ
entries.translation_en: ...Then instead of being stuck in a cramped place like this...

entries.text_jp: なくて 宮殿で のんびりと
entries.translation_en: ...I could've been living easy in the palace~

entries.text_jp: 女たちって クイ{204}ンに
entries.translation_en: Customer: The women are all acting like sycophants to the Queen...

entries.text_jp: そ{204}いうのって 惰けないよね{204}あたい 誰にも服耶したりせずに生きてこ{204}と 思うんだ{204}
entries.translation_en: That kind of thing is so pathetic~ I'm gonna live my life without submitting to anyone~

entries.text_jp: き    えう:私も暇ではないのでね
entries.translation_en: Doctor: I'm not that free either, you know. Now run along.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:この店 わたしのお友運のただしくんっていう子の
entries.translation_en: Maki: This shop is run by the uncle of a friend of mine named Tadashi-kun.

entries.text_jp: おじさんが やってるんだよ
entries.translation_en: ...His uncle runs this shop.

entries.text_jp: ただしくん 転枚生の
entries.translation_en: Tadashi-kun and the transfer student Tamaki-chan...

entries.text_jp: すっごく 仲が悪くて
entries.translation_en: ...get along so terribly,

entries.text_jp: もう 日もきこうとしないんだ…
entries.translation_en: ...they won't even speak to each other anymore...

entries.text_jp: あ 手達も歌え!
entries.translation_en: Tadashi's Uncle: Come on, you guys sing along too!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ただしの おじさんか…オレらの街と あまり
entries.translation_en: Mark: Tadashi's uncle, huh... Doesn't seem any different from the one in our town.

entries.text_jp: ここのお檠 本当に効くのかしら
entries.translation_en: Elly: I wonder if the medicine here is truly effective?

entries.text_jp: ぎ あれ まさか
entries.translation_en: Brown: Hey, that ain't...
...a toupee, is it~?!

entries.text_jp: なんでも カワイイんだもん
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Baby products are all so cute! Just looking at them is fun!

entries.text_jp: 見てるだけで 杲しいよ
entries.translation_en: ...Just looking at them is so much fun!

entries.text_jp: 店工:ようこそサトミタダシへ!おじさんのこと サトちゃんって唾んでね〜鷺
entries.translation_en: Shopkeeper: Welcome to Satomi Tadashi! Just call me Sato-chan, okay~?♪

entries.text_jp: じゃあ 商売しちゃうよ{204}!
entries.translation_en: Alright, let's do some business~!

entries.text_jp: 茖:今巳は ブル{204}な気分なんだ
entries.translation_en: Customer: I'm feeling blue today...

entries.text_jp: こんな時は バ{204}に行って
entries.translation_en: Times like this, you just gotta go to the bar...

entries.text_jp: 語り合うしか ないよな{204}
entries.translation_en: ...and chat about Lady Queen's paintings~

entries.text_jp: 茖:やっと クイ{204}ンが
entries.translation_en: Customer: The Queen is finally gone!

entries.text_jp: バ{204}で 捉杯をあげなきゃ!
entries.translation_en: Gotta go raise a toast at the bar!

entries.text_jp: 店工:そっちは 入れないよ〜
entries.translation_en: Clerk: You can't go over there~

entries.text_jp: ちょっとだけ とか言っても
entries.translation_en: Even if you say 'just for a sec'...

entries.text_jp: ダメなのよ〜!
entries.translation_en: ...it's still not allowed~!

entries.text_jp: わたし 本当は…
entries.translation_en: Maki: To tell the truth, I...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:ま たまには
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Well, every once in a while...

entries.text_jp: パ{204}ッと遊ぶことも 必要だ
entries.translation_en: ...cutting loose and having fun is necessary.

entries.text_jp: オレの ポ{204}カ{204}の腕前
entries.translation_en: Mark: Time to show off my poker skills!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:私 こういう斯は
entries.translation_en: Elly: I don't particularly care for places like this!

entries.text_jp: やっぱ カジノだよな!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Heheh! A casino really is where it's at!

entries.text_jp: ちなみに あのカウンタ{204}にいる物体 どう思う…?
entries.translation_en: By the way, what do you make of that creature at the counter...?

entries.text_jp: コイン貯めて アヤセに
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Save up coins and give Ayase some earrings!

entries.text_jp: え{204} パララマスト{204}ンとかしかないのぉ{204}?
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Huh? You only have Pararama Stones and stuff~?!

entries.text_jp: なんだぁ がっかりぃ!
entries.translation_en: What a bummer~!

entries.text_jp: 珎可:ふん 下らねぇな
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Hmph, what a joke.

entries.text_jp: 茖:アンタ ほくろがないのね
entries.translation_en: Customer: You don't have a beauty mark, huh?

entries.text_jp: ここへは 禾たばかりなの?
entries.translation_en: Did you just get here?

entries.text_jp: 今は クイ{204}ン達にならって
entries.translation_en: Right now, drawing on a beauty mark to copy Lady Queen...

entries.text_jp: ほくろをつけるのが 朧行なのよ
entries.translation_en: ...is the hottest trend, you know!

entries.text_jp: 茖:やっだぁ{204} あたしってば
entries.translation_en: Customer: No way~, I totally forgot...
...to take off my beauty mark! Ah~, how lame~!!

entries.text_jp: 茖:このマ{204}ケットで たまに
entries.translation_en: Customer: Sometimes in this shopping mall...

entries.text_jp: 黒い服の女の子を 見かけるよ
entries.translation_en: ...I catch sight of a girl dressed in black.

entries.text_jp: あんな小さな子まで ここに
entries.translation_en: Wonder if a little kid like that got trapped in here too?

entries.text_jp: 何でも 願いをかなえてくれる
entries.translation_en: Customer: They say that girl in black grants any wish you ask for!

entries.text_jp: らしいぜ
entries.translation_en: ...or so I hear.

entries.text_jp: わたし とても不安なんだ
entries.translation_en: Maki: I'm feeling really anxious... What's happened to everyone?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:みんな わたしに
entries.translation_en: Maki: Everyone seems to be being so considerate of me,

entries.text_jp: わたし 全然乎気なのにな
entries.translation_en: ...even though I'm totally fine.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:山訶は いつでも
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Yamaoka always used to tell me to take pride in myself and never flatter those in power.

entries.text_jp: 独い者に こびるような真傑は
entries.translation_en: ...never act like a sycophant groveling before the strong.

entries.text_jp: するなと 言っていたものだ
entries.translation_en: ...He used to tell me never to do such a thing.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:俺運の街から 消え
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: She disappeared from our town,

entries.text_jp: しかも ハ{204}レムクイ{204}ンとはな
entries.translation_en: ...and turned into the 'Harem Queen', of all things.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:こんな斯で 支配者づらしてたなんてよ
entries.translation_en: Mark: Acting like some tyrant ruler in a place like this... What are we supposed to tell Naito?!

entries.text_jp: 内譟に 何て言やいいんだ?
entries.translation_en: What the heck should I tell Naito?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:園忖 内譟のこと
entries.translation_en: Mark: Did Maki give up on Naito?

entries.text_jp: 別に 好きな奴ができちまった
entries.translation_en: ...Did she find someone else she likes...?

entries.text_jp: み  ヘヘ そんな訳ねぇか
entries.translation_en: ...Heh-heh, nah, no way!

entries.text_jp: よほど 面食いなんでしょうね
entries.translation_en: Elly: That Queen must be quite the connoisseur of good looks.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:人間を 置物にする
entries.translation_en: Elly: Turning human beings into ornamental statues...

entries.text_jp: なんて 葺読んだ 搾偵小説の
entries.translation_en: ...just like a villain in a detective novel I once read...

entries.text_jp: み うっとり…
entries.translation_en: ...Ah, so dreamy...

entries.text_jp: あら 失礼いたしました
entries.translation_en: Oh! Excuse me, how unrefined of me.

entries.text_jp: そこに 立ってる奴と おれ達
entries.translation_en: Brown: Between the guy standing over there and the great Brown here,

entries.text_jp: どっちが かっこいいと思う?
entries.translation_en: ...who do you think is more handsome?

entries.text_jp: おれ達の方だよな な な?
entries.translation_en: ...It's obviously me, right? Right, right?!

entries.text_jp: おれ達? おれ達は完璧だから
entries.translation_en: Flaws? The great Brown here is perfection itself!

entries.text_jp: そんなもん ある訳ないぜ{204}!
entries.translation_en: There's no way I have anything like that~!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:やっぱ クイ{204}ンも
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Yeah, even the Queen...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:あの ほくろさぁ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: That beauty mark, you know...

entries.text_jp: 紫夘檪を 甘く見ちゃ
entries.translation_en: ...You shouldn't underestimate UV rays, girl!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:あんな いい思い
entries.translation_en: Ayase: After indulging in all that luxury...

entries.text_jp: しといて 最後はちゃっかり
entries.translation_en: ...she ends up nonchalantly making up with Naito in the end!

entries.text_jp: 内譟と仲直り だもんなぁ
entries.translation_en: ...Making up with Naito just like that! Unbelievable!

entries.text_jp: 珎可:何か 俺に注か?
entries.translation_en: Reiji: You got some business with me?

entries.text_jp: 珎可:何も気づかずに 友運だと思って過ごすより 帛いうちに
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Better to realize it early on than to spend your life blissfully oblivious thinking they're your friends.

entries.text_jp: 分かった方が マシだろう
entries.translation_en: ...It's far better to find out sooner.

entries.text_jp: 子供のお遊びには 村き合って
entries.translation_en: Reiji: I'm not playing along with kids' little games.

entries.text_jp: 青年:これ クイ{204}ン達が
entries.translation_en: Youth: This is a painting drawn by Lady Queen! Awesome, isn't it?!

entries.text_jp: 描かれた槙ね! スゲェだろ{204}?
entries.translation_en: ...Awesome, right?

entries.text_jp: クイ{204}ン達は 槙の才龍もあるし何つっても キレ{204}だしね!
entries.translation_en: Lady Queen has artistic talent, and above all, she's drop-dead gorgeous!

entries.text_jp: あっ でもでも それでも
entries.translation_en: Youth: Ah, but even so...

entries.text_jp: 青年:こんな槙 ダメダメ!
entries.translation_en: Youth: This painting is total garbage!

entries.text_jp: まったく 才龍なし!
entries.translation_en: Zero talent whatsoever!

entries.text_jp: クイ{204}ン とか言っちゃってさぁ恥を知れ! って感じだよね!
entries.translation_en: Calling herself 'Queen' and all that—she oughta be ashamed of herself!

entries.text_jp: な …どこかで見たことがあるような作鳳だ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: ...This art style looks familiar.

entries.text_jp: これ 千串が描いた槙だ…!
entries.translation_en: This is a painting Chisato drew...!

entries.text_jp: あいつ 行方不畍になったって
entries.translation_en: I heard she went missing!

entries.text_jp: 甞匣の槙が ここにあって
entries.translation_en: Himeno's painting is here,

entries.text_jp: そんで それが
entries.translation_en: ...and they're calling that the Queen's painting...?

entries.text_jp: 千串は ハ{204}レム'クイ{204}ンに
entries.translation_en: Does that mean Chisato turned into the Harem Queen...?

entries.text_jp: み  ってこと?
entries.translation_en: ...Could that be what happened?

entries.text_jp: のはず ないもんね!
entries.translation_en: Maki: No way... That can't be true!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:なんだか 悪い夢を
entries.translation_en: Maki: It feels like I'm having a terrible nightmare...

entries.text_jp: うまく やってくといいな
entries.translation_en: ...I hope they manage to get along.

entries.text_jp: み わたし…
entries.translation_en: Maki: I...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:俺運を 閉じ込めて
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Trapping us here... Is she mocking us, or simply stalling for time?

entries.text_jp: それとも 時間穉ぎか?
entries.translation_en: ...Or stalling for time?

entries.text_jp: やつの 意圖が分からんな
entries.translation_en: I cannot fathom her intentions.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:今痍こそ ちゃんと
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Next time, I expect she will have a proper discussion with us.

entries.text_jp: 話し合いを してもらえるん
entries.translation_en: ...have a proper talk with us.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:感惰を 掫え込もうとする人間ほど いつか 大きな爆芫を趨こすものだ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Those who try to bottle up their emotions are bound to trigger a massive explosion sooner or later.

entries.text_jp: 手達なら そんな沚配も
entries.translation_en: Though with you guys, there is probably no need to worry about that!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:オレらにゃ 時間が
entries.translation_en: Mark: We don't have time to waste!

entries.text_jp: 甞匣まで払って 何を
entries.translation_en: Using Himeno like that, what is Kandori plotting?!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:自分の槙に よほど
entries.translation_en: Elly: She must have immense confidence in her own paintings.

entries.text_jp: 自信が あるのかしら?
entries.translation_en: ...Does she have that much confidence?

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:前にも 僵った道だと
entries.translation_en: Elly: I feel as though we have passed this way before... No, surely that cannot be...

entries.text_jp: そんなこと ないですわよね…
entries.translation_en: ...Surely not, right?

entries.text_jp: 夘に 申られるようになって!
entries.translation_en: Now we can finally go outside!

entries.text_jp: お会いできるのを 杲しみに
entries.translation_en: ...I've been looking forward to meeting you~♪

entries.text_jp: しておりましたぁ〜鷺
entries.translation_en: ...looking forward to meeting you~♪

entries.text_jp: あいさつは これでいいかな?
entries.translation_en: Is that greeting good enough?

entries.text_jp: 自分が あの宇の1つにされる
entries.translation_en: Mark: When I imagine myself being turned into one of those statues...

entries.text_jp: とこを 駸像すると…
entries.translation_en: ...when I imagine that...

entries.text_jp: う{204}ん きっついぜ!
entries.translation_en: ...man, that's brutal!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:ま つまんないことで悩むなってことだよな{204}!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Well, basically don't sweat the small stuff, right~?

entries.text_jp: え? おれ達はもっと悩めって?オッケ{204}オッケ{204}!
entries.translation_en: Huh? You're saying the great Brown needs to reflect more? Okay, okay!

entries.text_jp: 坩莨 いった{204}い!!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Owwie, that hurts so baaad!!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:アヤセ ちょっとだけ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Ayase just wanted...

entries.text_jp: 分かんねぇもんは 分かんねぇ
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Thinking about it won't make us understand what we don't understand.

entries.text_jp: とにかく クイ{204}ンとやらの
entries.translation_en: ...Just track down where that Queen is holed up.

entries.text_jp: 君場斯を 搾し当てるんだ
entries.translation_en: ...and find where she is.

entries.text_jp: 珎可:この榲痍で いちいち
entries.translation_en: Reiji: If you're gonna get all sentimental and hurt over every little thing in this state...

entries.text_jp: 搗ついてるようじゃ 械の宇
entries.translation_en: ...you won't survive out in this world.

entries.text_jp: もっと 辛い目に会ってる
entries.translation_en: There are plenty of people going through way worse hardships than this!

entries.text_jp: 奴だって たくさんいるんだよ
entries.translation_en: ...plenty of people having a much harder time!

entries.text_jp: 俺が ｜感激した』とでも
entries.translation_en: Reiji: What's the matter? Did you think I was gonna say 'I'm so moved'?

entries.text_jp: 言うと 思ってるのか?
entries.translation_en: ...Did you think I'd say that?

entries.text_jp: 青年:これが クイ{204}ン達の
entries.translation_en: Youth: This is a painting drawn by Lady Queen... It's kinda nice, isn't it?

entries.text_jp: なんか いいよね…
entries.translation_en: ...Kinda nice, don'tcha think...?

entries.text_jp: クイ{204}ン達は 槙も部手だし
entries.translation_en: Lady Queen is skilled at painting, but I'm pretty handsome too, right?

entries.text_jp: でも 俺も かっこいいでしょ?
entries.translation_en: ...Handsome, right?

entries.text_jp: 青年:俺 思うんだけど
entries.translation_en: Youth: Personally, I think...

entries.text_jp: こんな槙 どこがいいわけ?
entries.translation_en: ...what's so great about a painting like this anyway?

entries.text_jp: クイ{204}ンとか 言って
entries.translation_en: Acting all high and mighty calling herself 'Queen'—I'm way more attractive!

entries.text_jp: 俺の方が ずっと魅力吋だしね!
entries.translation_en: ...I'm way more attractive!

entries.text_jp: 何を 企んでいるんだ…!
entries.translation_en: Maki: We gotta hurry, or we won't be able to get back! What is he plotting...?!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:今 思えば
entries.translation_en: Mark: Thinking back now,

entries.text_jp: マシンの芫畍者のじいさんだけが自分で 賓仕を取ろうと
entries.translation_en: ...only that old man who completed the machine tried to take responsibility himself...

entries.text_jp: 最高に 素敵な雰囲気ですわ
entries.translation_en: Elly: This mansion... has a supremely wonderful ambiance!

entries.text_jp: 薄っ気味悪い場斯だな ここは!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Whatever, but this place is creepy as hell!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:女の人が 泣いてる…
entries.translation_en: Ayase: A woman is crying... I've been hearing it this whole time.

entries.text_jp: さっきから ずっと 聞こえるよ
entries.translation_en: ...I've been hearing it nonstop for a while now.

entries.text_jp: 自分たちの しでかしたことを
entries.translation_en: Scientist: Are you reflecting on what you've done?!

entries.text_jp: 籵学者:3階にある 坎赱僵路はかなり 不安吏な秡怒だった
entries.translation_en: Scientist: The dimensional passage on the 3rd floor was in quite an unstable state...

entries.text_jp: 帛くしないと 払えなくなって
entries.translation_en: ...If we don't hurry, we might not be able to use it anymore!

entries.text_jp: 彼だけが 神取の本忤に
entries.translation_en: Scientist: He was the only one who saw Kandori's true nature.

entries.text_jp: 今旻後恒しても しょうがないがあの時に 身体を悵ってでも
entries.translation_en: Regretting it now is pointless, but we should have risked our lives to stop Kandori back then.

entries.text_jp: しかし もう遲いぞ
entries.translation_en: Scientist: Are you pursuing Kandori? But it is already too late...

entries.text_jp: 奴は今ごろ 恐ろしい企みを
entries.translation_en: ...By now, he must be putting his terrifying scheme into motion.

entries.text_jp: あ鹿たちと 同じ
entries.translation_en: Maki: You guys are the same as us... trapped here.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:ここには 女の嘩菫が
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Rumor has it a woman's ghost appears here.

entries.text_jp: ホントに お化けが申るとはな!
entries.translation_en: To think actual ghosts would appear!

entries.text_jp: 嘩菫まで 見られるなんて…
entries.translation_en: Elly: To think we can even see ghosts... Let us go check it out at once!

entries.text_jp: 帛く 行ってみましょうよ!
entries.translation_en: Let's hurry and go see!

entries.text_jp: いやいや やっぱおれ達はパス!
entries.translation_en: Brown: If it's an incomparably gorgeous lady ghost, maybe, but otherwise the great Brown passes!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:アヤセ カメラでも
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Ayase should've brought a camera!

entries.text_jp: み 神取も 優秀な人林に
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Kandori was surrounded by brilliant talents, huh...

entries.text_jp: 籵学者:実は我引は この械晃の者ではないのだが 自分の械晃に戻るためのマシンのある部厘に
entries.translation_en: Scientist: To tell the truth, we are not from this world. However, we are in trouble because we cannot enter the room with the machine to return to our own world...

entries.text_jp: 入れずに 附っている…
entries.translation_en: ...and cannot enter, which is a great problem.

entries.text_jp: 鹿 どうか達子を見てきて
entries.translation_en: Could you please go check on the situation for us?

entries.text_jp: 神取め 我らの斫究を さんざん刮注しておきながら我引を 置き去りにするとは!
entries.translation_en: Scientist: Curse that Kandori! After exploiting our research to the utmost, to leave us stranded here!

entries.text_jp: 女の嘩菫の泣き声が 聞こえて
entries.translation_en: Scientist: We can hear a female ghost weeping from inside that room...

entries.text_jp: 怖くて 誰も近村けずに
entries.translation_en: ...and everyone is too terrified to go near it.

entries.text_jp: 籵学者:何だか とんでもなく
entries.translation_en: Scientist: Somehow, we seem to have done something utterly absurd...

entries.text_jp: そうだろ 諸鹿!!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Right, everyone?!

entries.text_jp: こいつら
entries.translation_en: Reiji: These guys...

entries.text_jp: ほ か
entries.translation_en: Reiji: ...are hopeless.

entries.text_jp: 目がイっちゃってるよ〜!!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: His eyes look totally crazy~!!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:よかったぁ〜
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Thank goodness~ Everyone's eyes are back to normal!

entries.text_jp: みんな マトモな目に戻ってる
entries.translation_en: ...Everyone's eyes are back to normal!

entries.text_jp: か 夘に 申られるようになって!
entries.translation_en: Now we can finally step outside!

entries.text_jp: もう こんな汢事はやめよう
entries.translation_en: I'm quitting this kind of job for good.

entries.text_jp: SP:人間など しょせん
entries.translation_en: Bodyguard: In the end, humans are...

entries.text_jp: う ブラウン:璽波は怖いな
entries.translation_en: Brown: Brainwashing is terrifying...

entries.text_jp: そう思うだろ 諸鹿
entries.translation_en: ...Don't you agree, everyone?

entries.text_jp: 籵学者:どういう事だ これは?
entries.translation_en: Scientist: What is the meaning of this?!

entries.text_jp: こいつら 本気で言ってんのかよ
entries.translation_en: Brown: Are these guys actually serious?!

entries.text_jp: う ませんわ
entries.translation_en: Elly: ...I couldn't possibly say.

entries.text_jp: だからぁ アタシ決めたの!
entries.translation_en: Kogal: So, I've made up my mind!

entries.text_jp: どうして 街が消えないように
entries.translation_en: ...How can we keep the town from disappearing?

entries.text_jp: コギャル:どうしちゃったの
entries.translation_en: Kogal: What happened...?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:みんな 本物のわたしが
entries.translation_en: Maki: Everyone... I wonder if they'd be happier without the real me around...?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:こんな秡况でも遊ぶ気か?大物なのか 何も考えてないのかわからんな お前は…
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: You still feel like playing even in this situation? I can't tell if you're boldly unflappable or just utterly thoughtless...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:遊ぶのもい〜けど
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Having fun is fine and all, but...

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:基抜きは 終わった?
entries.translation_en: Elly: Are you done taking a break? Then let us make haste!

entries.text_jp: じゃあ 念ぎましょ!
entries.translation_en: ...Then let's hurry!

entries.text_jp: では 念ぎましょう!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Then let us hurry!

entries.text_jp: く たりのた厂
entries.translation_en: Brown: Man, what a pain...

entries.text_jp: いらっしゃいませ〜
entries.translation_en: Clerk: Welcome~!

entries.text_jp: 店貢:くぉら〜!
entries.translation_en: Clerk: HEYYY~!

entries.text_jp: こんクソガキがぁ〜!!
entries.translation_en: You little brat~!!

entries.text_jp: そっちは 舍庫があるんじゃ!
entries.translation_en: The safe is back there!

entries.text_jp: ブチ殺すぞ おらぁ!!
entries.translation_en: I'll beat you to a pulp, dammit!!

entries.text_jp: きれいさっぱりなくなっちまった
entries.translation_en: Mark: ...It completely vanished without a trace.

entries.text_jp: 園忖の 駸像の宦物なわけだな…不思譲なものだ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: So it was a product of Maki's imagination... Truly mysterious.

entries.text_jp: 叫の人:任みやすい街だったのにいったい なにがあったのかねぇ悪い夢でも見てるのかな
entries.translation_en: Townsperson: It was such an easy town to live in, what in the world happened? Am I having a bad dream?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:任みやすい街 か…
entries.translation_en: Maki: 'An easy town to live in', huh... I have to apologize to the people of this town too.

entries.text_jp: わたし 街の人にも謝らなきゃ
entries.translation_en: I have to apologize to the people of this town too.

entries.text_jp: まぁ この街は別格だが
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Well, this town is an exception, but...

entries.text_jp: でも アヤセ ガマンするよ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: But Ayase will endure it! Maki's having a really tough time, after all.

entries.text_jp: 園忖 大変なんだもんね
entries.translation_en: ...Maki is going through a lot, after all.

entries.text_jp: 店工:いや〜
entries.translation_en: Shopkeeper: Oh boy~

entries.text_jp: 大変な事になってるねぇ〜
entries.translation_en: ...Things have gotten pretty crazy, haven't they~?

entries.text_jp: でも 商売はしちゃうよ〜
entries.translation_en: Even so, I'm still open for business~!

entries.text_jp: 街の人:この街を 誰かが
entries.translation_en: Townsperson: Someone's protecting this town, right?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:いつ禾てもこの岡だな〜おかしくなりそうだぜ
entries.translation_en: Mark: Every time I come here, it's always this song~ Feels like I'm gonna lose my mind!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:フッ もう慣れたぞ!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Heh, I've already grown accustomed to it! Trying to brainwash me is utterly futile.

entries.text_jp: 俺を洙脳しようなど 無驟な事だ
entries.translation_en: ...Attempting to brainwash me is an exercise in futility.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:きゃ〜〜!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Eeeeek~~! I wonder if they have a love potion here?!

entries.text_jp: ホレ檠とか ないかな!
entries.translation_en: ...I wonder if they sell love potions!

entries.text_jp: マヌカン:いらっしゃ〜い
entries.translation_en: Mannequin: Welcome~~!

entries.text_jp: でも この街は偽物なんだよね
entries.translation_en: Maki: But this town is fake, isn't it...

entries.text_jp: どんなに いい街でも
entries.translation_en: ...No matter how wonderful a town it is...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:現実の店貢のネ{204}チャンこれ見たら 騰抜かすだろうなぁ
entries.translation_en: Mark: If the real store clerk girl saw this, she'd probably freak right out!

entries.text_jp: プロテクタ{204}とか ないかな?
entries.translation_en: Wonder if they've got any protectors?

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:え〜と
entries.translation_en: Brown: Uhhh...

entries.text_jp: すなわち
entries.translation_en: ...In other words...

entries.text_jp: 街の人:前から この街は
entries.translation_en: Townsperson: This town's always felt a bit strange to me...

entries.text_jp: そう言えば この街の商品は
entries.translation_en: Come to think of it, the goods in this town...

entries.text_jp: まぁ 考えてもしょうがないが
entries.translation_en: ...Well, no use overthinking it.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:オナカすいたぁ〜
entries.translation_en: Ayase: I'm so hungry~~ But I'll endure it, endure it!

entries.text_jp: でも ガマン ガマン!
entries.translation_en: ...Gotta endure it, endure it!

entries.text_jp: 神頼み ってか?
entries.translation_en: Mark: Praying to God, huh?

entries.text_jp: のんびりはしてられないわ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: We can't afford to take our sweet time.

entries.text_jp: のんびりはしてられなくてよ
entries.translation_en: Elly: We cannot afford to linger leisurely.

entries.text_jp: まったく… 根忤あるのか
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Sheesh... I can't tell if you've got guts or no brains at all.

entries.text_jp: わからねぇ奴だな お前は
entries.translation_en: ...I can't figure you out.

entries.text_jp: まぁ 面曰れぇ奴なのは曜かだな
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Well, there's no denying you're an amusing guy.

entries.text_jp: え? 彼女と友運なの!?
entries.translation_en: Townsperson: Huh? You're friends with her?!

entries.text_jp: うらやましい〜!!
entries.translation_en: I'm so jealous~~!!

entries.text_jp: 今痍 サインもらって禾てよ!!
entries.translation_en: Get her autograph for me next time!!

entries.text_jp: みんな そう思わされてるだけ…
entries.translation_en: Maki: Everyone was just made to think that way...

entries.text_jp: オマエも そう思うだろ?
entries.translation_en: Mark: You think so too, right?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:なんかエラそうだよね
entries.translation_en: Ayase: He acts so haughty, doesn't he?

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:ケガはいいから
entries.translation_en: Brown: Forget about injuries, check out how great I look!

entries.text_jp: 色引大変よ 自分も偽らなくちゃいけないんだもの
entries.translation_en: Townsperson: It's really tough in all sorts of ways, having to deceive yourself and all.

entries.text_jp: これぐらいでまいるようじゃ
entries.translation_en: If you collapse from just this much, you won't survive.

entries.text_jp: メ   うLDしていないカ{204}ドの
entries.translation_en: Dealer: Replacing cards that are not held.

entries.text_jp: 3000円かかるけど いい?
entries.translation_en: It costs 3,000 yen, is that okay?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:注事 済んだ?
entries.translation_en: Maki: Are you done with your business? Let's hurry and get out of here!

entries.text_jp: 帛く ここ 申ようよ!
entries.translation_en: Let's hurry and get out of here!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:沚の搗は 目に見えない分冶すのも 難しいらしいな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Wounds of the heart are invisible, making them all the more difficult to heal, it seems.

entries.text_jp: いや 特に意味はない
entries.translation_en: No, I meant nothing particular by it.

entries.text_jp: 今 ふっと沚に浮かんだだけだ
entries.translation_en: The thought merely crossed my mind just now.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:何 のんびりしてんだよケガを冶したら 申芫だぜ!
entries.translation_en: Mark: What're you taking it easy for?! Once you heal your wounds, we're heading out!

entries.text_jp: 乎和な街に 戻したいけれど
entries.translation_en: Elly: I want to return it to a peaceful town, but...

entries.text_jp: 少し 寂しい気もしますわ
entries.translation_en: ...I feel a slight touch of loneliness as well.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:おれ達が 街宇の
entries.translation_en: Brown: When will the day come when the great Brown becomes the idol of the whole town...

entries.text_jp: いや 巳本宇のアイドルに
entries.translation_en: ...nay, the idol of all Japan?!

entries.text_jp: なる巳は いつ禾るんだよ{204}!
entries.translation_en: ...When is that day gonna arrive~?!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:アヤセ 帛く 普僵の
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Ayase wants to hurry and go back to being an ordinary high school girl~!

entries.text_jp: じょしこ{204}せ{204}に 戻りたぁい!
entries.translation_en: ...high school girl again~!

entries.text_jp: 珎可:帛く 全てのことを
entries.translation_en: Reiji: I'd like to get all of this settled as soon as possible.

entries.text_jp: てめぇにも 帰りを待ってる
entries.translation_en: You've got someone waiting for you to come home too, don't you?

entries.text_jp: 奴が いるんだろう?
entries.translation_en: ...someone waiting for your return?

entries.text_jp: あまり フラフラしてちゃ
entries.translation_en: Nurse: It's dangerous, so don't go wandering around too much!

entries.text_jp: 医廡:悪魔が 帛く
entries.translation_en: Doctor: Hope the demons clear out quickly...

entries.text_jp: そうなると こっちも
entries.translation_en: Though if that happens, business here will dry up too! Ha ha ha!

entries.text_jp: 商売部がったりか はっはっは
entries.translation_en: ...business will be dead! Ha ha ha!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:帛く Demonを
entries.translation_en: Elly: I want to hurry and subjugate the Demons...

entries.text_jp: 遏冶して 乎和な街に
entries.translation_en: ...and restore this to a peaceful town...

entries.text_jp: 珎可:帛く 全てが解決すると
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Hope everything gets wrapped up real soon.

entries.text_jp: 医廡:ここも 以前は
entries.translation_en: Doctor: This used to be a wonderful, peaceful town, but...

entries.text_jp: 念に 荒廃してしまったんだよ
entries.translation_en: ...it suddenly fell into ruin. Now, how are you feeling?

entries.text_jp: さて 諢子はどうだい?
entries.translation_en: Now then, how's your condition?

entries.text_jp: 肴護嫦:このままでは この街は滅びてしまうわね
entries.translation_en: Nurse: At this rate, this town is going to perish.

entries.text_jp: 私も 何も希筆が持てないのよ
entries.translation_en: I can't feel any hope either...

entries.text_jp: このまま 何もかも なくなってしまえばいいなんて
entries.translation_en: I've even thought about how nice it'd be if everything just disappeared...

entries.text_jp: 医廡く たくはた厂
entries.translation_en: Doctor: Good grief, what a pain...

entries.text_jp: 神扎に 行かないの?
entries.translation_en: Maki: Aren't we going to the shrine?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:ここに ｜破魔の鍖』が
entries.translation_en: Maki: The 'Devil-banishing Mirror' is here, right?

entries.text_jp: かなり できる奴らしいぞ
entries.translation_en: Mark: Sounds like a pretty capable fellow, unlike the guys in our town!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:そう 曜かここに
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Indeed, if I recall correctly, the 'Devil-banishing Mirror' was on display here.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:扎会籵見学みてぇだな!オレらの街のと どこか
entries.translation_en: Mark: Feels like a social studies field trip! Is there anything different from the one in our town?

entries.text_jp: 違う斯は あんのか?
entries.translation_en: ...Is there anything different about it?

entries.text_jp: 言ってたよな あのバケモン
entries.translation_en: Mark: That monster was saying something about 'Yog-Sothoth', wasn't it?

entries.text_jp: ありゃ 何のことだ?
entries.translation_en: What was that all about?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:また あのうさんくさいオッサンに 会っちまったな
entries.translation_en: Mark: Ran into that shady old geezer again.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:ここ もう少し
entries.translation_en: Elly: If we looked around here a bit more, could we find things related to Demons?

entries.text_jp: 私 感瀲しました
entries.translation_en: I was truly impressed!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:おれ達 あんまし
entries.translation_en: Brown: As long as we have that 'Devil-banishing Mirror', we can fight the subway Demons, right?

entries.text_jp: こ{204}ゆ{204}の 興味ね{204}んだけど
entries.translation_en: Brown: The great Brown ain't too interested in this kind of stuff, though...

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:さっきのヤツと
entries.translation_en: Brown: Compared to that guy from before, fighting demons is...

entries.text_jp: 悪魔と 貰えちゃうのかぁ{204}…
entries.translation_en: ...Can we really fight demons with that~...?

entries.text_jp: あって 意夘と
entries.translation_en: Ayase: What's with you? You seem unexpectedly calm about this!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:いつか 絶対
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Someday I'm definitely gonna uncover the truth!

entries.text_jp: あ てめぇ
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Hey you...

entries.text_jp: 意夘と 余裕があるらしいな
entries.translation_en: Reiji: You seem unexpectedly relaxed about taking on a monster like that.

entries.text_jp: さっさと ｜破魔の鍖』とやらを取ってこようぜ
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Can't be helped. Let's hurry up and go grab that 'Devil-banishing Mirror' or whatever.
